author: Giulia Messmer
title: Im Streit Berlin vs. Rom: Sea-Watch Stellungnahme
content:
Während der Streit zwischen Rom und Berlin um die Aufnahme asylsuchender Menschen kocht, meldet die Internationale Organisation für Migration mehr als 1.700 Tote und Vermisste im Mittelmeer. Allein seit dem 4. August sind mehr als 55 Leichen gefunden worden. Im Streit der beiden Regierungen forderte die italienische Seite eine finanzielle Entschädigung für die Menschen, die seit Oktober 2022 von deutschen Organisationen aus Seenot gerettet und in italienischen Häfen an Land gebracht wurden. Nun kündigte Verkehrsminister Matteo Salvini an, keine asylsuchenden Personen aus Deutschland mehr aufzunehmen, obwohl die erst vor 10 Wochen in Kraft getretene Reform des Europäischen Asylsystems GEAS eine solche Ablehnung nicht vorsieht. Das Rettungsschiff der Organisation Sea-Watch wurde zudem nach der Rettung von 6 Personen für 45 Tage im Hafen von Neapel festgesetzt.

Giulia Messmer, Sprecherin der Organisation Sea-Watch kommentiert:

22.500 Leben sind unbezahlbar. Wer Gerettete zu zwischenstaatlicher Verhandlungsmasse macht, verschweigt die eigentliche Frage: Warum private Organisationen überhaupt retten müssen, wo staatliche Rettung längst hätte stattfinden sollen. Dass Organisationen wie Sea-Watch retten, ist die Folge jahrelanger tödlicher Politik in Brüssel, Rom und auch Berlin. Denn Deutschland pocht zwar auf europäische Regeln, doch an der eigenen Grenze bricht es sie. Wer Salvini kritisiert, darf Dobrindts Abschottungspolitik nicht verschweigen.

Dass kaum 10 Wochen nach dem Inkrafttreten der Reform des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Asylsystems ein solcher zwischenstaatlicher Streit eskaliert, zeigt, was Menschenrechtsorganisationen seit Jahren sagen: GEAS hat den Konstruktionsfehler des Dublin-Systems nicht behoben, sondern neu verpackt. Die Reform zerfällt in der Praxis, kaum dass sie angewendet werden soll.

Das sofortige Ende der Behinderung ziviler Seenotrettung

Retten statt Reden. Ein öffentlich finanziertes, ziviles europäisches Seenotrettungsprogramm.

Ein verbindlicher europäischer Aufnahmemechanismus nach der Ausschiffung von Geretteten, der die Bedürfnisse Schutzsuchender ins Zentrum stellt.

Sichere Fluchtrouten, um dem Sterben auf dem Mittelmeer ein Ende zu setzen.

title: День независимости от Украины. Об альтернативах временной защите после ограничений для украинских граждан в ЕС
content: Итак, с 5 августа действуют новые правила предоставления временной защиты, принятые Советом ЕС. Теперь нужно доказать, что ты выехал через пункт пропуска и/или что твои военно-учётные документы в порядке, с помощью приложения “Резерв+” (также называемого “Ресурс 200”). Хотя в разных местах по-разному и практика только формируется, обязанность подтвердить освобождение от “долга перед родиной” на продлевающих временную защиту, по общему правилу, не распространяется, так что условный Марафоненко Потужнослав Незламирович, собирающийся сегодня где-то в Германии махать на митинге желто-голубой тряпкой, может пока не волноваться. Понятно, что нововведение порадовало фашистских людоедов: им в принципе невыносимо, что кто-то смеет спокойно жить без их разрешения, так что усложение жизни хотя бы некоторым согражданам вызывает восторг и ликование. Но зачем голосят про “всё пропало” их оппоненты? Ходоки через мексиканскую пустыню в США, которых на пике этого дела в 2022 г. погибло больше 850-ти, прекрасно знают, что какое-то время придется жить без документов. Не останавливают сложности с легализацией и людей из Африки или Сирии, десятки тысяч которых с 2014 г. нашли смерть в волнах Средиземного моря, спасаясь от нищеты и насилия. Так что “без временной защиты нет смысла выходить” – это только для тех, кому и так живется терпимо. Как изложил 6 августа житель харьковского микрорайона Восточный, который зимой сделал репортаж о путешествии на разведку и отдых в Карпаты, да так и не вышел: “Сама идея покинуть страну у меня появилась только год назад…. Я не думал, что все может насколько затянуться… в голове не укладывалось. Я зимой мог выйти реально) но такой ппц был… как будто меня проказа посетила, проблемы сыпались прям как из рога изобилия. Не успел, проблемы с деньгами были, пока решил… Сижу читаю инфу пока. Ну как есть, я сам виноват. Значит, так хотел выйти, видимо. Долго не мог определиться, че делать в ЕС… но уже всё. Снаряга есть та, что осталась после зимнего похода. Меня очень сильно тормознул товарищ, который вышел полтора месяца назад. Получил 6 отказов после Румынии в разных странах, по очереди фактически. И щас сидит в Швеции без защиты, ждет решения. Первая подача 24 июля была, теперь 6 августа заставили переподаться, после этого решения, вступившего в силу. Говорит, отношение как к г*вну, злой до ужаса. То есть, если и выходить, то понимая, что дальше Румынии уже по сути всё. В Бельгии сказали месяц ждать надо, но у него денег не было, а лагерь на 3 дня только. И он уехал… там был тип, жил в палатке, ждал защиту)) Не к добру это все, так ведь и могут взяться за тех, кто в ЕС… я уже понял, им ничего не стоит. Мне, в принципе, есть и в Харькове чем заняться еще год. Но хотелось бы активности больше социальной. Живу не по прописке, хожу в радиусе 3 км. В центре был последний раз 3 месяца назад. Я технический дизайнер, с опытом работы на станках ЧПУ лазерных, плоттером и шелкографии. У меня цех был до этого всего. Долго не мог определиться, че делать в ЕС… но уже все. Сам виноват, когда мои пацаны выходили, надо было с ними идти. Брат двоюродный в сентябре 22-го выехал на машине)) говорит, погнали, 200 долл. цена вопроса. Район Богодухова, там лазейка была, он в РФ выехал, там в РБ и дальше в Европу”. Молдова даёт временную защиту как обычно. Можно и не брать, а с одним штампом о пересечении границы выехать в ЕС по безвизу на 90 дней или сразу с пригласом на работу. Приднестровским особистам вообще все равно, какой у тебя паспорт, пусть даже образца СССР, как у многих живущих в этой непризнанной республике (можно также выйти с нотариально заверенными ксерокопиями доков). К говорившемуся о переходе молдавской границы и о первых впечатлениях вышедшего добавляем обновления от народных экспертов за это лето: “Я живу через Дунай с Румынией, дрон каждый день вижу над поселком. В Измаиле, особенно вид с пляжа возле крепости, выглядит вообще супер, на первый взгляд, переплыл да и всё, но давно уже никто не переплывал. Арциз, сёла к Молдове глухие, в теории, лестницу 4 м с собой, и ровчик перейти. Там есть Дмитриевка Болградского района, между Арцизом и Болградом, я думаю, к ним до сих пор никто не суётся, после того как они автобус с Беркутом перевернули (где-то в 2000-х), и Молдова совсем рядом. Очень дружные гагаузы. Вряд ли поддерживают нынешний режим и будут кого-то сдавать. Но там приняли парнишу местного пару месяцев назад. Чтобы проехать в Паланку, нужна как минимум прописка в каком-то населенном пункте Бессарабии …

author: infolibre
title: Συγκλονίζουν οι 300 του κέντρου κράτησης κολαστήριιο της Σιντικής: Είμαστε παγιδευμένοι, ζώντας σαν τους νεκρούς!
content:
Η εξέγερση των μεταναστών στο κολαστήριο της Σιντικής Σερρών ήταν η αναμενόμενη απάντηση στη βαρβαρότητα των ναζιστικών μεθόδων του υπουργού (κατά της) Μετανάστευσης και Ασύλου Θ. Πλεύρη με την επιβολή του δόγματος «να τους κάνουμε τον βίο αβίωτο», «φυλακή ή απέλαση».


Συγκλονιστική επιστολή προς τον αδελφό ελληνικό λαό, εκ μέρους 300 φυλακισμένων μεταναστών στο στρατόπεδο Σιντικής.


Αλληλεγγύη στην εξέγερση μεταναστών στο κολαστήριο της Σιντικής Σερρών.


ΚΕΕΡΦΑ


Από τη Θέουτα μέχρι τη Σιντική, ώρα να τσακίσουμε τον ρατσισμό των κυβερνήσεων.


Πανελλαδική κινητοποίηση στη Θεσσαλονίκη στη ΔΕΘ, 5 Σεπτέμβρη, Αγ.Βενιζέλου, 6μ.μ.


Η εξέγερση των μεταναστών στο κολαστήριο της Σιντικής Σερρών ήταν η αναμενόμενη απάντηση στη βαρβαρότητα των ναζιστικών μεθόδων του υπουργού (κατά της) Μετανάστευσης και Ασύλου Θ. Πλεύρη με την επιβολή του δόγματος «να τους κάνουμε τον βίο αβίωτο», «φυλακή ή απέλαση». Ο πρόεδρος της κοινότητας Προμαχώνα μίλησε ξεκάθαρα για τις συνθήκες κράτησης ανθρώπων που δεν διέπραξαν κανένα έγκλημα παρά μόνο ζήτησαν άσυλο στην Ελλάδα: «Στο καμπ η θερμοκρασία έφτασε προχθές τους 45 βαθμούς ενώ το χειμώνα είναι στους μείον 10» (!)


Η τακτική του βασανισμού μέχρι θανάτου και αν θέλει κάποιος να τον αποφύγει να υπογράψει «εθελοντική» αποχώρηση από τη χώρα θυμίζει τις εποχές που στα στρατόπεδα αναμόρφωσης του κράτους της Δεξιάς μετά τον εμφύλιο ζητούσαν δηλώσεις μετάνοιας και χρησιμοποιούσαν συστηματικά βασανιστήρια, ανάμεσα τους και η παρατεταμένη έκθεση στον καυτό ήλιο.


Οι μετανάστες δεν άντεξαν τις εξοντωτικές συνθήκες αλλά και την παρατεταμένη κράτηση πάνω από ένα χρόνο για κάποιους από αυτούς. Είναι αντίθετοι με τις απελάσεις και ζητάνε δουλειά στη Ελλάδα.


Τι ίδιες μέρες μετανάστες 9 μετανάστες ξεκίνησαν απεργία πείνας στο στρατόπεδο συγκέντρωσης Κορίνθου ζητώντας την απελευθέρωση τους.


Η κυβέρνηση της ΝΔ παίζει ξεδιάντροπα το χαρτί του ρατσισμού για να εκτρέψει την οργή από τη δολοφονική πολιτική της και να συσπειρώσει τα ορφανά της Χρυσής Αυγής μπροστά στην κατάρρευση της.


Αυτό το καλοκαίρι, ένδεκα άνθρωποι έχασαν την ζωή τους στον βωμό του κέρδους και της διάλυσης της προστασίας των δασών: πυροσβέστες, πιλότοι ελικοπτέρων, κάτοικοι κάηκαν ζωντανοί. Η κυβέρνηση δίνει δισεκατομμύρια για εξοπλισμούς και ρατσιστικές καταδιώξεις μεταναστών στα σύνορα, χτίσιμο στρατοπέδων θανάτου στις Σέρρες και τα νησιά αντί για καναντέρ, προσλήψεις μονίμων στις υπηρεσίες δασοπυρόσβεσης αλλά και σε νοσοκομεία, σχολεία και Δήμους.


Η ρατσιστική εκστρατεία από τη Θέουτα μέχρι τη Σιντική είναι ώρα να πάρει την απάντηση που της αξίζει. Να πεταχτεί στον σκουπιδοτενεκέ της ιστορίας πριν εξοντώσει περισσότερους μετανάστες. Είναι ώρα να γίνει η δίκη στο ναυτοδικείο και να πάνε φυλακή οι δολοφόνοι των 600 προσφύγων της Πύλου. Καμία συγκάλυψη στην εγκληματική πολιτική των pushback, της αποτροπής που κόστισε την ζωή σε αν των 600 προσφύγων στη Πύλο.


Στη Μεσόγειο, από την Πύλο μέχρι τα στενά του Γιβραλτάρ, η ρατσιστική πολιτική των κλειστών συνόρων της ΕΕ-φρούριο δολοφόνησε πάνω από 30.000 πρόσφυγες τα τελευταία 15 χρόνια. Με περισσό θράσος, οι χώρες που ρήμαξαν την Αφρική με την αποικιοκρατία και συνέχισαν με τις επιδρομές της Παγκόσμιας Τράπεζας και του ΔΝΤ επιδιώκουν να χτίσουν σε αυτές στρατόπεδα εξορίας προσφύγων που φτάνουν στην Ευρώπη για να αποφύγουν τον θάνατο.


«Φυλακή ή απέλαση» κραυγάζει και επιμένει ο Θ. Πλεύρης για να κρατήσει τα σύνορα κλειστά για τους φτωχούς μετανάστες και κατατρεγμένους πρόσφυγες, ενώ την ίδια ώρα αφήνουν τον Golden visa να αλωνίζει στις γειτονιές, τινάζοντας στα ύψη τα νοίκια και επιβάλλουν δουλεμπορικές συμφωνίες μετακίνησης εργατικού δυναμικού από άλλες χώρες με αποτέλεσμα ατυχήματα-δολοφονίες μέσα σε συνθήκες δουλειάς-σκλαβιάς από το Ελληνικό και τον Βοτανικό μέχρι το Μετρό.


Η ασφάλεια και η ποιότητα ζωής των κατοίκων στις γειτονιές δεν κινδυνεύει από τους πρόσφυγες αλλά από την πολιτική της κυβέρνησης της ΝΔ που σπέρνει τη φτώχεια, με την ακρίβεια, τα ψηλά νοίκια και τις περικοπές στις κοινωνικές υπηρεσίες.Την απάντηση θα δώσουν τα συνδικάτα, ντόπιοι και μετανάστες ενωμένοι, στη μεγάλη Πανελλαδική κινητοποίηση στη ΔΕΘ στη Θεσσαλονίκη, στις 5 Σεπτέμβρη, με συλλαλητήριο στο Αγ. Βενιζέλου, στις 6μ.μ. για να βάλουμε τέλος στην κυβέρνηση του πολέμου, της φτώχειας και του ρατσισμού.


Καμιά δίωξη των εξεγερμένων, άμεση απελευθέρωση των προσφύγων της Σιντικής.


Τέλος στις ρατσιστικές πολιτικές της ΕΕ-φρούριο. Σύνορα ανοιχτά για την προσφυγιά. Στη φυλακή οι δολοφόνοι της Πύλου.


Να …

author: Unknown
title: ABD mahkemesi Trump'ın 75 ülkeden gelen göçmen vizelerini askıya alma kararını durdurdu
content:
Washington - ABD Bölge Yargıcı Jeannette Vargas, Trump yönetiminin, vatandaşlarının ABD'de kamu yardımına ihtiyaç duyma ihtimalini yüksek bulduğu Afganistan, İran, Rusya ve Somali dahil 75 ülkeden vize işlemlerini askıya alan politikasını, "yasaya aykırı" olduğu gerekçesiyle iptal etti.

Vargas, ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio'nun "uygun başvuru sahiplerine, hukuki hiçbir dayanağı olmaksızın vize verilmesinin reddedilmesini" zorunlu kılan politikasının, "yetkiyi aştığını" ve bunun Göç ve Vatandaşlık Yasası'na aykırı olduğunu belirtti.

Bu politikanın aynı zamanda vizeyi onaylama konusunda konsolosluk memurlarını ilk sıraya koyan Kongre kararını da "baltaladığını" vurgulayan Vargas, "Kongre, bu memurlara, kanunda belirtilen özel ve ayrıntılı kriterleri inceleyerek bir göçmenin vize almaya uygun olup olmadığını belirleme konusunda münhasır yetki ve takdir hakkı vermiştir." değerlendirmesinde bulundu.

Yargıç Vargas, "Başvuranın uyruğuna göre göçmen vizesi verilmesini kategorik olarak yasaklayan bu politika, bu yasal düzenlemenin doğrudan ihlalini temsil etmektedir." ifadesini kullandı.

Dışişleri Bakanlığı, kasımda yürürlüğe giren ve "kamuya yük getirebilecek" potansiyel göçmenlerle ilgili kuralları sıkılaştıran daha geniş bir emir uyarınca, konsolosluk görevlilerine 75 ülkeden gelen göçmen vize başvurularını durdurma talimatı verdiğini duyurmuştu.

Bakanlık, Ekonomik Danışmanlar Konseyi verilerine dayanarak, bu ülkelerden göçmen bulunan hanelerin yüzde 30'undan fazlasının bir tür kamu yardımı aldığını kaydetmişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Martyr Culture
content:
This essay was generously written by Sara Blum, an internationalist who spent several years with the YPJ in Rojava, published 2025.


„I remain committed, until the end, to the struggle for liberation


and to the beauty and love it creates.“


Abdullah Öcalan


Kurdish friends, upon meeting an internationalist, often ask about our decision to come to their homeland in Rojava, Kurdistan. When they'd ask how I first came into contact with the friends, I felt a bit embarrassed to say that, honestly, the first friends of the movement I met were those who helped me after I actually arrived in Mesopotamia. (Editor's note: “The friends” is a colloquialism stemming from the literal translation of the word “heval” which has historically been used by members of the Kurdish liberation movement to refer to each other.) I told them I learned about the movement by reading articles on a few different anarchist websites and contacted the friends by email. In fact, I knew so little about the movement that I first emailed YPG (People's Protection Units) instead of YPJ (Women's Protection Units). The friends were often amazed at this, and in their generosity considered it some kind of bravery or indication of the depth of my belief in the revolution and the people, rather than of naivety or impulsivity. It's a common story among internationalists from the so-called USA, because the Kurdish Freedom Movement doesn't have a presence here like it does in many parts of Europe, where there is a bigger Kurdish diaspora. When I initially went, I planned to stay for six months or a year. I ended up staying for several years, and for most of that time I was with the autonomous women's military defense forces, YPJ.


I decided to go in late 2018, and at that time it was hard to find much information about what to expect. Not much has changed in that regard. My dad told me to bring extra socks, and that before going I must read Che Guevara's On Guerrilla Warfare. Other than that, most of the practical information about what to bring I received from an internationalist fighter whom I reached through an online message board. He said to bring all sorts of supplies, sent a packing list, and told me to bring a bunch of US dollars. He emphasized that I should bring water for border crossing across the mountains, which he said would be long and difficult, but to not share my water because the Kurdish comrades would pass it down the line until there was none left, and then I wouldn't have water. The YPJ friend I was corresponding with told me I didn't need much, and if it came to be that I needed something when I got there or along the way, comrades would sort it out then. This seemed to me rather casual at the time. I felt frustrated at the vagueness.


Packing and repacking my bag, researching the weather conditions, trying to prepare as much as possible for what could be the rest of my short little life, I wanted all the information I could find and there wasn't much. I didn't realize then that I was encountering the first contrast of revolutionary and capitalist culture: different modes of being. The internationalist from the message board, with his best intentions, showed me one way to go about struggle, while the YPJ comrade showed me another way of joining the revolution. Preparing myself as an individual by making sure I had all the right specific things on the one hand, and on the other, preparing myself to take on the same circumstances as whomever I end up with and to sort all my needs within the context of our collective needs. As an internationalist from the West, the tension between these tendencies has long lived in me. I find that it still does, but I have also found that being out of water together always seems to be better than having water while the person next to me doesn't.


Before I left, I tried many times to write letters to my family, close friends, and comrades, which I would leave in the hands of a trusted friend so that, in the event of my death, they could be sent. I was determined to leave loved ones with some words of strength—I didn't want to die, but since it was a distinct possibility, it was important to ensure that my death would not be a weight or darkness in their lives. I had made this decision for myself, but I realized as time went on that I'd also made a decision for many other people. My mother became the mother of a YPJ fighter defending the Women's Revolution. My close friends in the U.S. became personally …

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: US Immigration Agents Caught Spying on Leftwing Activists
content:
US Homeland Security agents have been engaged in a widespread spying operation this year against labour unions, a climate change group and socialist collectives, as well as other left-leaning organisations.


Operation Puppet Master, the

 first

 of two surveillance campaigns, began four days after intensive care nurse

Alex Pretti was shot dead by ICE agents

 during January’s protests against Donald Trump’s crackdown on immigrants in Minneapolis,

the New York Times reports

.


In the aftermath of Pretti’s death,


Homeland Security officials turned their attention to leftwing activists. Investigators were tasked with looking into funding to see if organisations had provided “

violent opportunists and agitators

” with resources for protests.


Undercover agents infiltrated events – including meetings held online and at churches, parks and libraries – to spy on protesters and organisers. Agents also went as far as

summoning

 three years worth of financial records from some of its surveillance subjects, including environmental direct action group Sunrise Movement and the Communication Workers of America, a labour union. 


The Service Employees International Union, the largest union representing healthcare workers, also had three years of wire transfers investigated. The AFL-CIO, the largest union federation, the Democratic Socialists of America and Showing Up for Racial Justice were also investigated. 


None of the organisations has been charged with a crime, but the investigations have led to the prosecution of 15 people accused of conspiring to obstruct federal immigration officers.


Court filings reveal that the covert operations continued for months after the immigration crackdown in Minnesota had ended.


The investigations were made public after a defence lawyer representing one of the Minneapolis protesters facing criminal charges filed a request calling on the court to compel the government to hand their reports over as evidence.


Kevin Riach, the lawyer who filed the request, pointed to the “de-humanising terms” used by the Trump administration to describe leftwing organisers. “These wild conspiracy allegations are born from the fantasies of political retribution that animate the Trump administration,” Riach

wrote in a court filing

.  


“President Trump and senior administration officials routinely speak of the political left in de-humanising terms – as ‘deformed, ‘scarred,’ and ‘filled with ugliness,’ for example. The administration has crystallised these sentiments into policies that encourage and authorise political prosecutions like this one.”

author: Elizabeth Weill-Greenberg, Ethan Corey
title: Deportation Dollars: ICE Contracts With More Than 1,000 Businesses Across the U.S.
content:
With billions of dollars to spend, the Trump administration has entered into contracts with hundreds of companies, both big and small, to execute its deportation agenda. Since January 20, 2025, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has awarded $8.4 billion dollars to more than 1,100 companies, according to The Appeal’s analysis of data available on the government spending website

usaspending.gov

. 


The Appeal’s investigation reveals a widespread web of public and private entities enabling Trump’s deportation machine. We’re publishing the results of our investigation

in a database

 so users can identify companies and governments in their area working with ICE. 


Find ICE Contractors Near You


Our investigation found ICE contractors in nearly every state. Use our searchable database to browse contracts in your state, county, or ZIP code.


Search the full database.


ICE has awarded approximately $154 million in contracts for combat training, weapons, and related items, such as restraints, handcuffs, leg restraints, and belly chains. The agency also entered into contracts worth about $77,000 for “Sniper Training Equipment,” and a

contract for about $19,900 with a company called ShivWorks

 for “Defensive Tactic Knives for law Enforcement Training courses.” Last week, the Associated Press reported that the agency was

planning to purchase gloves

 that deliver electric shocks. 


The largest recipient of weapons spending, Atlantic Diving Supply, has received nearly $100 million. 


But much of ICE’s spending involves more banal goods and services essential to the everyday functioning of the agency, including approximately:


$52 million for office furniture; 


$4.3 million for roofing contractors;


$1.2 million for interior design services; and


$2.1 million for parking space leases.


The One Big Beautiful Bill Act, signed into law last year,

allocated $75 billion to ICE

, to be disbursed over the course of four years, or about $18.7 billion a year. That funding was on top of the $10 billion Congress had already given to ICE for fiscal year 2025. ICE now has a

larger budget

 than any other federal law enforcement agency. 


In addition to private companies, ICE has also entered into contracts with several local governments. 


Last year, the City of Arlington in Texas

entered into an about $50,000 contract

 to provide the “ICE Office of Human Capital with a 3-day venue” for a hiring expo for law enforcement candidates. Earlier this year,

ICE entered into a contract

 with the

town of Lancaster, New York

 for “a rental of a secured parking facility … for storage and deployment of up to 164 government vehicles.” 


The agency also

contracted with the City of Cottage Grove

 in Minnesota for the rental of a firearms range facility to train law enforcement officers in the “St. Paul Area of Responsibility.” The contract was for about $118,000 and ran from August 1, 2025 through July 31, 2026. Earlier this year, immigration officers shot and killed two protesters in Minneapolis, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, in addition to

shooting Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis

, who survived.. Since last year, federal immigration officers have

shot at least 23 people

 nationwide, according to a New York Times investigation.


The summary of a contract for

medical supplies with Altitude Technologies

 states that the “the purpose of this contract award is to provide compact trauma kits essential for medical emergencies and critical incidents to enhance ICE personnel survival during encounters involving severe hemorrhage or penetrating chest wounds.” 


There is no mention of using the supplies for people who are injured by ICE officers.


ICE did not respond to The Appeal’s request for comment on this contract.

Subscribe to our newsletters for regular updates, analysis and context straight to your email.


Sign Up


Activists from across the country have launched campaigns to demand businesses, police departments, and local governments cut ties with ICE. 


Last year, after ICE agents flooded Los Angeles, activists

staged “No Sleep for ICE” protests

author: Unknown
title: Ergun: The state’s struggle against Kurds aims to eliminate remnants of the commune - Part Two
content:
Many left-wing and socialist organizations in Turkey oppose the communal organization that the Freedom Movement has adopted as a foundation of its new paradigm, approaching it as a “betrayal of socialism.” These debates can also be clearly seen in statements by various circles.


Writer and political scientist Mahir Ergün said that the commune represents a model of organization contrary to orthodox understandings of socialism and nation-state-centred approaches to socialism. He said that communal organization is not based on centralism but on locality, autonomy, self-governance and self-defence. Within this framework, Ergun argues that communal organization is possible.


The first part of this interview can be read

here

. 


Below, the second part.


Is the commune distinct from nation-state socialism?


This depends on what we understand by socialism. If we are talking about nation-state socialism based on the industrial working class, the commune can only be a stage that must ultimately be overcome on the way to socialism. But if by socialism we mean democratic, solidaristic and communal social relations based on mutual aid, locality, autonomy, self-governance and self-defence, then the commune is not a stage but the foundation.


To put it simply, we can say that socialists generally take relations of production as their basis and emphasize the exploitation of labour. Rather than allowing the surplus value produced by the working class to be appropriated by a parasitic class, they advocate using it for the benefit of society as a whole. There is a demand for a welfare state with advanced industry, developed education and healthcare services, as well as for social justice. Although the question of political will is not completely overlooked, it generally remains secondary. The emphasis is primarily on the economy. The system described in many socialist narratives can be seen, if not entirely, at least in some respects, in countries such as Canada and Sweden.


In a commune-based understanding, however, although relations of production and the economy are important, the main emphasis is on democratic will. The central issue is the ability of the members of the commune to socialize their political will. The main concern is to replace centralism with locality and to base relations on solidarity. What is understood by communalism is not merely the sharing of property, but also the sharing of decision-making processes and ensuring the broadest possible participation in them. Moreover, this should be understood not only in terms of relations among people, but also as integration with nature, of which human beings are a part.


From a communalist perspective, the problem of exploitation is not limited to a parasitic class exploiting the surplus value produced by workers; it also encompasses political and cultural exploitation and the exploitation of nature. Therefore, the communalist understanding is not progressivist. It is opposed to the welfare state. It takes the self-sufficiency of the community as its basis. Its concern is not with the distribution of surplus value, but with its production. It is not consumerist; in other words, it does not support the exploitation of human labour and nature for the production of numerous unnecessary consumer goods. Instead, it advocates producing less.


Seen from this perspective, the understanding described here does not resemble the ideology of socialism that we have come to know since the 19th century. That is why I say we should call it communism. However, if this is what we define as socialism, then we should not be considering any form of organization other than the commune.


What do the experiences of communes to date show us?


It is difficult to make a generalization about ‘the experiences of communes to date,’ because every practice has its own particular characteristics. Every practice that can be examined should be studied individually, and different lessons should be drawn from each one. Moreover, the commune should not be regarded as an ‘experiment.’ In other words, it is not something artificial, synthetic or experimental. It is a fundamental way of life for the human species. It existed for thousands of years. Over the past few centuries, the state process has sought to eliminate it. But it has not disappeared completely. Therefore, we need to look at the traces that still exist.


We give examples from Western Europe because the records and historical sources …

author: Sicilia Libertaria
title: Un altro clima è possibile
content:
Crisi climatica.


C’è una frase che i movimenti per il clima ripetono spesso: questa non è l’estate più calda della storia, è l’estate più mite dei prossimi anni. Un apparente paradosso che in realtà sintetizza bene l’apparente ineluttabilità del collasso climatico in atto. Se mai ce ne fosse bisogno, la torrida estate del 2026 ha confermato quanto siano urgenti le lotte ambientali. Pensare che ogni anno sarà sempre un poco peggio, e pensare che in fondo come esseri umani siamo una specie capace di adattarsi a (quasi) qualsiasi cosa, costituiscono in fondo due facce della stessa medaglia. In cui viene meno il “qui e ora” di ogni lotta. Perché se la lotta climatica non è diventata ancora così centrale è perché, banalmente, si tratta di una sopraffazione al rallentatore, quotidiana, che agisce su ogni aspetto delle nostre vite. Si dirà: è il capitalismo. Ma è un po’ più complesso di così. L’estate è diventata una stagione sempre meno attesa e sempre più temuta. Da una parte il termometro sale, l’asfalto si scioglie, i boschi bruciano, gli ospedali si riempiono di persone ricoverate per colpi di calore. Dall’altra riparte il rito estivo dell’informazione: le mappe con le città più infuocate, l’ossessione per i record di temperatura, i servizi sui ventilatori esauriti. E ovviamente i consigli degli esperti, ora pure sui social: bevete molto, uscite poco, mangiate leggero. Poi in autunno dimenticheremo tutto. Resettiamo ogni sofferenza, ogni dato, ogni malore. Di più: negli ultimi anni si è diffusa la tendenza di provare a resistere stoicamente all’estate. Specie le persone più consapevoli. Fa un caldo estremo? E noi comunque ci concediamo l’aperitivo, organizziamo i festival, . Si è diffusa una specie di diritto alla sofferenza. Manco prendiamo precauzioni, tranne poi lamentarci del tutto tempo del caldo che non è normale, figurarsi se possiamo concepire che il collasso climatico si possa fermare. Oh, è estate, rilassiamoci. Con questo caldo? Come se il caldo –  e le conseguenze del caldo come gli incendi e la siccità –  fossero un incidente della natura e non il risultato di un ordine economico che ha deciso, molto tempo fa, di trasformare l’atmosfera in una discarica e il pianeta in un bilancio d’impresa. Il capitalismo ama raccontare le conseguenze e cancellare le cause. È una delle sue più grandi abilità. Così il collasso climatico diventa “maltempo”, “anomalia”, “emergenza”. Mai un modello di produzione. Mai una precisa responsabilità politica. Mai un sistema economico costruito sulla convinzione che la crescita infinita fosse possibile dentro un mondo finito. Eppure i numeri parlano con una chiarezza che nessuna conferenza stampa riesce più a coprire. Secondo il servizio europeo Copernicus, giugno 2026 è stato il giugno più caldo mai osservato nell’Europa occidentale e il secondo più caldo a livello globale. I dati di EuroMOMO, l’osservatorio europeo sulla mortalità sostenuto dall’Organizzazione mondiale della sanità, mostrano oltre 10 mila decessi in eccesso registrati durante le ondate di calore di fine giugno (per molto meno nel 2020 l’Europa si è fermata per arrestare la pandemia di coronavirus). Intanto le ondate di calore non sono più eccezioni ma stanno diventando la normalità. Una normalità costruita a colpi di petrolio, gas, cemento e consumo senza misura.La Sicilia è una delle prime a pagare il conto. A metà luglio i satelliti del programma Copernicus hanno registrato temperature della superficie del suolo superiori ai 47 gradi sulle pendici dell’Etna, mentre in diverse aree interne le stazioni meteorologiche hanno superato i 46 gradi dell’aria. Numeri che oggi scorrono nel flusso delle notizie, come se fossero inevitabili. Ma di inevitabile non c’è nulla. Non è inevitabile avere città costruite come enormi piastre di cemento che moltiplicano il calore. Non è inevitabile aver distrutto alberi, campagne e zone umide per sostituirli con centri commerciali, parcheggi e capannoni. Non è inevitabile continuare a finanziare combustibili fossili mentre si pronunciano solenni discorsi sulla transizione ecologica. Queste sono scelte. Scelte che hanno nomi, cognomi, consigli di amministrazione e governi che le difendono. Ecco perché il collasso climatico non è soltanto una conferma evidente degli orrori del capitalismo. E’ qualcosa di più, perché presuppone la nostra capacità di costruire un mondo nuovo, diverso, che non cerchi compromessi col capitalismo. Basta un solo esempio su tutti. Per decenni le grandi …

title: Patrick Mérin - Théisme, nationalisme, capitalisme… les religions vont bien
content:
Auteur·e

: Patrick Mérin

Titre

: Théisme, nationalisme, capitalisme… les religions vont bien

Date

: 2017

Source

: Extrait le 23 août 2026 de

https://le-cafe-anarchiste.info/theisme-nationalisme-capitalisme-les-religions-vont-bien/


 Faut-il crier avec les loups contre la religion théiste islamique actuellement médiatisé ? Non. Le mouvement libertaire révolutionnaire (ne parlons pas de certains signataires du confusionniste « appel des libertaires contre l'islamophobie ») est clair concernant les religions (théistes, nationalistes, capitalistes) depuis bien longtemps. ni contre l'une ni contre l'autre des religions en particulier, mais contre toutes les religions qui de fait enrégimentent les consciences/vivants dans des idées/relations totalitaires, guerrières et qui laissent perdurer, pour la cause, la soumission/domination et l'exploitation des humains par d'autres. L'objet de la critique est ici les religions révélées (islamique notamment mais les autres aussi) mais aussi les religions capitalistes et nationalistes (O/NU/TAN) qui imposent selon leur croyance un monde de soumission. L'objectif est aussi de répondre à nombres de propos ou réflexions de compagnons de travail (musulmans et autres) avec qui j'ai pu éprouver l'actualité et la non profondeur de certaines réflexions, tendant à réduire un individu à une communauté, à une religion de naissance ou à une couleur de peau.


 Que des personnes croient en une entité « supérieure » (Dieu/Nation/Capital) pourrait ne pas être spécialement problématique, tant qu'il n'y aurait pas de volonté prosélytique, expansionniste ni des conséquences néfastes sur les vivants. Le problème est que ces croyants s'identifient à un livre sacré/une frontière/un code de loi, qui veut imposer la croyance à tous et qui interdit d'exprimer/expérimenter ses refus/critiques sur les pratiques/écrits dits sacrés/intangibles. Quand on croit au bien d'une telle Entité, on ne devrait pas à avoir à l'imposer, et pourtant ils l'imposent de gré ou de force... La plupart des croyants considèrent qu'ils doivent suivre la croyance/tradition familiale. Hors si ce qui les intéresse est leur entité, ils ne devraient pas avoir besoin d'un livre, d'une frontière, d'un code de loi pour expliquer/vivre cette entité. Seule leur conviction intime, leur ressenti, devrait suffire, hors on peut remarquer que les religions théistes (thora, bible, coran…), nationalistes (français, allemand, marocain, algérien, …), capitalistes (propriétaire, locataire, salarié, marché, main invisible, …) sont généralement prosélytes et enrégimentent les consciences dans des « communautés » imaginaires pour mieux manipuler le sentiment « collectif ». D'ailleurs, un croyant même si il n'est pas extrémiste, de fait, permet aux extrémistes de poser leur logiques en s'appuyant sur la masse des croyants. Un compagnon croyant n'est pas apriori mon ennemi, l'ennemi est le militant théiste/nationaliste/capitaliste/hiérarchiste qui a une démarche proactive afin d'imposer son dogme. Néanmoins, un compagnon croyant se repose sur une entité que l'on peut manipuler sur la forme ou le fond et pour laquelle tout est bon, un peu de rhétorique et l'affaire est dans le sac, ça peut aller d'un sens ou d'un autre, quand certains disent paix, d'autres disent guerre, car dans les écrits dites sacrés des entités on trouve ce qu'on veut bien y trouver… Le seul moyen efficace de dégager ces militants religieux est de ne plus croire à leur religion (de croire à ce qu'on croit sans intermédiaire), et non essayer d'adoucir leurs croyances par des réformes ou des bons sentiments, sinon ils s'appuient sur les croyants de leur religion pour asseoir leur pouvoir, leur folie.


 En effet, les religions, sont des milieux d'hypocrisie, de haine et de guerre larvée ou directe, qui ne peuvent s'empêcher de mentir / abrutir / menacer / exclure / opprimer / massacrer afin d'instaurer LEUR PAIX. La paix des Dieux, la paix des Nations, la paix des Capitaux, ils en ont jamais assez, alors lorsque leur PAIX est menacé, ils font la guerre. Les différentes religions monothéistes se font la guerre entre elles, les différentes religions nationalistes se font la guerre entre elles, les différentes religions capitalistes se font la guerre entre elles, et il y a évidemment la guerre entre les différentes variétés de religions nationalo-théisto-capitalistes… Combien de millions de morts du fait de ces entités ? Trop, malheureusement. Évidemment, comme rien ne doit être …

author: antimilitarismus
title: Military “Anarchists”
content:
We are publishing a translation of an article criticizing pseudo-anarchists who call for support of participation in the war on the side of the Ukrainian state. It was published in the German anarchist anti-militarist newspaper Graswurzelrevolution.

– / Español / Русский / Volunteering for war in the name of the nation and democracy? The growing rift among anarchists over the question of war. A text that has been circulating online since November clearly demonstrates just how deep the chasm has grown between people, organizations, and media outlets that call themselves “anarchist.” “On the Suppression of Eastern European Voices at Anarchist Events in the EU,” reads the title of a complaint drafted by “Solidarity Collectives” and signed by numerous groups, collectives, and individuals. The list of signatories to the English-language version is longer and includes, among others, FAU Frankfurt, the French CNTF, and well-known authors such as Peter Gelderloos and Philipp Kellermann. The text laments that the anarchist community accuses those who voluntarily take up arms to fight in the war of “supporting the war.” The following conclusions are drawn from this: in recent years, many organizations and groups have emerged within the anarchist community that either actively exclude of block the participation of “Solidarity Collectives,” AChK-Belarus, and many other anarchist and anti-authoritarian organizations from public events. In addition, numerous “statements” have been published condemning the work of these groups and their support for the Ukrainian resistance against the Russian invasion. This behavior is often based on misrepresentations of the positions on the war held by activists from Eastern Europe. Anarchists are accused of having become militarists, of supporting the war, or of not being sufficiently critical of the Ukrainian state.” What draws the most serious attention is the very surprise that anyone would oppose supporting Ukrainian nationalism against Russian nationalism. Evidently, there has never been—and there still is not—consensus within contemporary anarchism regarding the nature of states and nations. The text not only uses the euphemism “Ukrainian resistance against the Russian invasion” (but what else is war? One state attacks, another resists with its military force), but it also stays mum over the fact that as recently as August 2025, “Solidarity Collectives” attempted to disrupt an event organized by the Assembly collective from Kharkiv. In a statement issued in connection with this, “Solidarity Collectives” and their supporters were convincingly characterized as exactly what they are—“anarcho-militarists” (https://communaut.org/de/von-winnyzja-bis-berlin). Are deserters and opponents of military service (from all warring sides), along with all those who do not want to die or kill for either side in this war, not “Eastern European voices”? Or is the identity card only in play when it comes to positions that fit into one’s own worldview? Or is memory so short that no one can recall how unceremoniously consistent opponents of the war were treated in Saint-Imier? (https://www.graswurzel.net/gwr/2023/09/ueber-militarisierung-ukrainesol…) “We do not see any support for war or state militarism in any form in the work of ‘Solidarity Collectives’ and ACHK-Belarus,” the text continues. “Furthermore, we categorically condemn any attempt to isolate anarchist collectives from Eastern Europe on the issue of resistance against the Russian regime’s military expansion.” On the one hand, this is untrue; on the other, it contradicts the assertion made in the same breath. Anyone who attended the “[Russian] opposition marches” in Berlin in November 2024 (https://knack.news/11396) and in December 2025 could have seen the “anarchist bloc” demanding arms deliveries to Ukraine (https://www.woz.ch/2447/russische-opposition/fuer-ein-ende-des-imperium…). Clearly, a military victory over Russia requires ever-increasing arms production, arms deliveries, and the use of weapons. And foremost, it requires more and more people who will allow themselves to be senselessly slaughtered in the struggle between various capitalist states. Ultimately, it doesn’t matter whether their justifications are anarchist, feminist, socialist, religious, liberal, conservative, or fascist—what matters is that they are armed, trained, and ready for battle.

Anyone seeking a military victory over Putin must not want their comrades from right-wing …

author: Thomas More
title: Ideology as Material Power - Wilhelm Reich
content:
The opening chapter of Reich’s landmark The Mass Psychology of Fascism, translated by Theodore P. Wolfe under Reich’s supervision from the revised and enlarged third-edition manuscript (1946).

The German revolutionary movement before Hitler was based on the economic and social theory of Karl Marx; an understanding of German fascism, therefore, presupposes an understanding of Marxism.

Shortly after National Socialism came to power in Germany, doubts about the correctness of the Marxist concepts of the social process were voiced even by people who for many years had actively proved their revolutionary convictions. These doubts were caused by a fact which, though at first unintelligible, was nonetheless beyond doubt: fascism, the most extreme exponent of political and economic reaction, had become an international phenomenon and in many countries had clearly gained the upper-hand over the socialist revolutionary movement. The problem was accentuated by the fact that this phenomenon was most pronounced in the highly industrialized countries. The international growth of nationalism was accompanied by a failure of the workers’ movement; this during a phase of modern history which the Marxists called “economically ready for an overthrow of the capitalist mode of production.” In addition to this failure, there was the burning memory of the failure of the Workers’ International at the beginning of the first world war and of the revolutionary movement outside of Russia between 1918 and 1923. Thus the doubts about the correctness of the Marxian theories seemed to be supported by weighty facts. Now, if the basic Marxian concepts were indeed erroneous, then the workers’ movement needed a thorough reorientation. If, on the other hand, these doubts were unfounded, if the basic Marxian concepts of sociology were correct, then, a thorough analysis of the continuous failures of the workers’ movement was needed, and, even more than that, an elucidation of the new mass movement of fascism. Only this could lead to a new revolutionary policy.

Certainly, no change for the better could be expected unless this were done. It was perfectly clear that neither appeals to a “revolutionary class consciousness” nor the then fashionable method of denying failures and of camouflaging important facts with illusions could lead anywhere. One could not be content with the fact that the workers’ movement also “progressed” here and there. For the decisive factor is not that progress is being made, but how much progress is being made in relation to the international progress of political reaction.

The young movement of work-democratic sex-economy is interested in a thorough clarification of these questions not only because it is a part of the fight for social freedom in general, but chiefly because the attainment of its goals is inextricably linked with the attainment of the economic goal of natural work democracy. We shall, therefore, use the workers’ movement as an illustration of the interlacing of the special sex-economic problems with the general social problems.

In many German meetings around 1930 revolutionaries, such as Otto Strasser, who were intelligent and honest though their thinking was somewhat nationalistic and mystical, would say to the Marxists: “You Marxists always point to the theories of Marx. Marx taught that theory is confirmed only in practice. But you always come up with explanations for the defeats of the Workers’ International. Your Marxism has failed. The defeat in 1914 you explain with the ‘defection of the Social Democrats,’ that of 1918 with their politics of betrayal.' And now you have new 'explanations’ for the fact that in the present world crisis the masses turn to the right instead of the left. But your explanations do not alter the fact of these defeats! Where, in the past eighty years, has there been any confirmation of the social revolution by practical action? Your basic error is that you deny or ridicule the mind which moves everything, instead of comprehending it.” These were the arguments of many revolutionaries, and the Marxists had no answer to them. It became increasingly clear that their political mass propaganda did not reach anybody except those who already belonged to the left front, simply because this propaganda referred to nothing but the objective socio-economic processes (capitalist production, economic anarchy, etc.). The elaboration of material needs, of hunger alone, was not sufficient, for that …

title: Türkiye iktisadının öncülerinden Prof. Dr. Gülten Kazgan toprağa veriliyor
content:
20 Ağustos Perşembe günü aramızdan ayrılan, Türkiye’de iktisat düşüncesinin, tarım ekonomisi ve kalkınma çalışmalarının öncü şahsiyetlerinden; Türkiye ekonomisinin tarımdan sanayileşmeye, dışa açılmadan krizlere ve küreselleşmeye uzanan dönüşümünü uzun dönemli ve ekonomi-politik bir çerçevede çözümleyen başlıca iktisatçılardan Prof. Dr. Gülten Kazgan için cenaze töreni, 22 Ağustos 2026 Cumartesi (bugün) öğle namazının ardından Marmara Üniversitesi İlahiyat Fakültesi Camii’nde yapılacak.


Kazgan’ın cenazesi, namazın ardından Çamlıca Mezarlığı’nda defnedilecek.


İstanbul Üniversitesi İktisat Fakültesi’nin kıdemli öğretim üyelerinden, İstanbul Bilgi Üniversitesi’nin kurucu rektörü Prof. Dr. Gülten Kazgan’ın vefat haberini İstanbul Üniversitesi İktisat Fakültesi Mezunları Cemiyeti, “Hocaların hocası Prof. Dr. Gülten Kazgan’ı kaybetmenin üzüntüsü içindeyiz” sözleriyle duyurdu.


İstanbul Bilgi Üniversitesi de Kazgan’ın üniversitenin kuruluşunda öncü rol üstlendiğini ve akademik vizyonuyla kurumun temellerinin atılmasına katkıda bulunduğunu açıkladı.


Prof. Dr. Gülten Kazgan’ın yaşamı ve yapıtları


Gülten Kazgan’ın Türkiye iktisadı açısından önemi, yalnızca birkaç kuşak iktisatçının yetişmesine yaptığı katkılar dolayısıyla haklı olarak edindiği “hocaların hocası” vasfından ibaret değildi. Prof. Dr. Kazgan, “soyuttan somuta yükselen” yaklaşımıyla Türkiye ekonomisinin tarımdan sanayileşmeye, dışa açılmadan krizlere ve küreselleşmeye uzanan dönüşümünü, bütün alanların birbirleriyle ilişkileri ve Türkiye’nin dünya ekonomisi içindeki yeri üzerinden uzun dönemli bir çerçevede çözümledi. Böylece Türkiye’yi genel iktisat teorilerinin yalnızca bir uygulama alanı olarak görmek yerine, kendi tarihsel belirlenimleri içinde kavranması gereken ekonomik bir bütün olarak ele alarak bir “Türkiye iktisadı”nın kuruluşuna paha biçilmez katkıda bulundu.


5 Haziran 1927’de İstanbul’da doğan Kazgan, Arnavutköy Amerikan Kız Koleji’nin ardından 1946’da İstanbul Üniversitesi İktisat Fakültesi’nde öğrenimine başladı. 1950’de mezun oldu. Kısa süre Türkiye Sınai Kalkınma Bankası’nda çalıştıktan sonra, Türkiye’de iktisat alanında henüz sınırlı sayıda kadın akademisyenin bulunduğu bir dönemde, mezun olduğu fakültenin öğretim kadrosuna asistan olarak katıldı.


“Tarımsal Gelirin İstikrarsızlığının Uzun Dönem Eğilimleri” başlıklı teziyle doktorasını tamamladı. 1957’de Rockefeller bursuyla, doktora sonrası çalışmaları içi  Chicago Üniversitesi’ne gitti ve daha sonra Nobel Ekonomi Ödülü’nü kazanacak Theodore W. Schultz ile iki yıl çalıştı. Türkiye’ye döndükten sonra “Türkiye Ziraatında Arz Fonksiyonu” başlıklı doçentlik tezini hazırladı ve 1961’de doçent oldu.


Tarım Kazgan için yalnızca tarım değildi


Kazgan’ın akademik çalışmalarının ilk önemli alanı tarımsal ekonomiydi. Ancak onu Türkiye iktisat yazınında ayrı bir yere taşıyan, tarımı kapalı bir sektör olarak değil, kalkınma, gelir bölüşümü, sanayileşme ve dış ticaretle ilişkileri içinde ele almasıydı.


1960’larda yayımlanan

Tarım Ekonomisi ve İktisadi Gelişme

başlıklı çalışmasında Türkiye tarımının verimlilik, fiyat, gelir ve yapısal dönüşüm sorunlarını iktisadi gelişme çerçevesinde inceledi. Doktora ve doçentlik çalışmalarından beslenen bu yaklaşımı daha sonra

Tarım ve Gelişme

 başlıklı yapıtında genişletti.


Kazgan’ın tarım çalışmalarında belirginleşen temel meselelerden biri, Türkiye ekonomisinin farklı kesimleri arasındaki kaynak ve gelir aktarımı süreçleriydi. Özellikle 1980 sonrasında tarımın göreli gelir kaybını, Türkiye’nin dışa açılma politikalarını, tarımsal desteklerin niteliğini ve dış ticaret koşullarını birlikte ele aldı. 1992’de yayımlanan bir çalışmasında 1980’lerde liberalizasyon ve dış ticaret hadlerindeki bozulmanın tarımda üretkenlik ve üretim artışını yavaşlattığını, gelir dağılımını tarım aleyhine çevirdiğini ve tarımsal ithalatı artırdığını savunuyordu.


Ekonomiyi yalnızca büyüme oranları, fiyatlar ya da tek tek piyasalardan değil; sektörler, toplumsal kesimler, devlet politikaları ve dünya ekonomisi arasındaki ilişkilerden hareketle çözümleme yaklaşımı, Kazgan’ın sonraki çalışmalarının da ayırt edici özelliği oldu


İktisat düşüncesini kuşaktan kuşağa taşıyan yapıtı 


Kazgan’ın en etkili yapıtlarından biri olan

İktisadi Düşünce / Politik İktisadın Evrimi

author: Redazione_web
title: Basta cemento e speculazione. Giù le mani dagli Orti Urbani!
content:
La Federazione Anarchica Livornese esprime solidarietà al Collettivo degli Orti Urbani di Via Goito e fa appello a partecipare alle iniziative di mobilitazione contro nuovi progetti di speculazione nell’area che per 14 anni è stata un laboratorio di autogestione e autorganizzazione dal basso.


Con la vendita degli Orti Urbani ad un noto costruttore locale ed il conseguente ordine di sgombero emesso dal Tribunale di Livorno si vorrebbe chiudere uno degli ultimi spazi aperti e vivi della città nato nell’intenso periodo di lotta contro le politiche di disoccupazione e miseria nei primi anni dello scorso decennio. Da allora gli Orti Urbani continuano ad essere un riferimento per la lotta contro la cementificazione, la speculazione e la svendita della città.


Facciamo appello ad unirsi alla lotta in difesa degli Orti Urbani, per difendere tutto quello che in città hanno rappresentato e continuano a rappresentare.


Una forma di riappropriazione collettiva, tramite l’azione diretta, contro il dominio della proprietà privata.


Uno spazio di autogestione, dove negli anni moltissime persone sono venute in contatto con forme di organizzazione diverse da quelle autoritarie imposte dallo Stato e dal Capitale.


Un luogo in cui praticare forme di autodeterminazione alimentare e sperimentare forme diverse di orticoltura.


Uno spazio di incontro, di confronto e dibattito oltre che di condivisione di pratiche e conoscenze, che ha ospitato negli anni moltissime iniziative.


Uno spazio non cementificato, sotto cui scorrono corsi d’acqua, che contribuisce alla sicurezza idrologica del territorio – pensiamo ai morti e ai danni dell’alluvione del 2017.


Uno spazio verde che costituisce una risorsa fondamentale in questa fase di crisi climatica, oltre ad essere rifugio e habitat per molte specie animali.


Tutto questo rischia di essere cancellato per interessi e profitti che, come sempre, sono posti al di sopra della salvaguardia dell’ambiente e di una vita migliore per tuttx.


La minaccia di sgombero per gli Orti Urbani si inserisce in un più generale contesto che ha visto negli ultimi anni una forte restrizione delle libertà di espressione e manifestazione per i proletari. Negli ultimi anni il governo guidato dai fascisti eredi del MSI ha imposto nuove leggi liberticide che impongono anni di carcere e multe salatissime per normali pratiche del movimento operaio e dei movimenti di lotta in genere. Occupazioni, blocchi stradali, manifestazioni non preavvisate. Proprio perché sono pratiche di massa, tali leggi faticano ancora ad essere applicate a tappeto.


Questo è stato reso evidente dal grande movimento dello scorso autunno in solidarietà al popolo palestinese e contro la guerra che ha raggiunto a Livorno importanti risultati con scioperi, blocchi, occupazioni di edifici e di aree portuali che hanno coinvolto migliaia di persone, riuscendo a inceppare la catena di approvvigionamento militare statunitense e israeliana.


La repressione giudiziaria ha iniziato a colpire alcunx compagnx di diverse realtà, mentre il prefetto continua a minacciare gli spazi autogestiti in città; ma se pensano di togliere le basi a nuove iniziative di lotta si sbagliano di grosso, perché il movimento è stato ampio e radicato in diversi settori della società, dai posti di lavoro alle scuole.


Per fermare la cementificazione degli Orti Urbani bisogna respingere ogni tentazione di gioco istituzionale che non può che portare acqua alla politica del potere locale del PD, sempre più fallimentare e sempre la stessa: provare a governare la crisi con la trattativa e la spartizione del potere. Per rilanciare un movimento sui temi più ampi del clima, della città, dello sfruttamento, dobbiamo saper tenere insieme, su un piano di orizzontalità, le diverse esperienze che hanno costituito gli Orti Urbani.


FEDERAZIONE ANARCHICA LIVORNESE


L'articolo

Basta cemento e speculazione. Giù le mani dagli Orti Urbani!

author: subMedia auf Deutsch
title: Solidarität mit Johann Sainea: Anarchistischer Gefangener des Kolumbianischen States
content:
Johann Sainéa Rubio sitzt seit 2021 in kolumbianischer Haft. Er wurde strafrechtlich verfolgt, weil er am Massenaufstand im selben Jahr teilgenommen hatte. Seit dem die rechtsextreme Regierung unter Abelardo de la Espriella die Macht in Kolumbien übernommen hat, hat sich seine ohnehin schon sehr schlechte Lage noch weiter verschlechtert. Der kolumbianische Staat schränkt die Lebensmittelversorgung ein, wodurch Johann und andere Gefährtinnen, die im ganzen Land inhaftiert sind,Systematisch auszuhungern werden. Das soll ihre Gesundheit nachhaltig schädigen, nachdem sie für Würde und Freiheit gekämpft haben.


Anlässlich der Internationalen Woche der Solidarität mit anarchistischen Gefangenen in diesem Jahr rufen wir dazu auf, Johann und seinen Genoss*innen etwas Luft zum artmen zu verschaffen, damit sie einen besseren Zugang zu Wasser und Nahrung erhalten!


Oder wie Johann immer sagt: „Solidarität ist Liebe und Verständnis, die in Taten umgesetzt werden.”


Zeigt eure Solidarität mit Johann und seinen Genoss*innen, indem ihr ein über den folgenden Link etwas spendet:


https://chuffed.org/project/197444-solidarity-with-johann-sainea

author: Radikal Perspektif
title: Planlarımız
content:
Komünistler ve Kolektivistler Arasındaki Birlik


Yazan: Errico Malatesta


Çeviren:

Gorthim


Çevirilen Asıl Metin


PDF Linki


Bazı dostlarımız, sunduğumuz ve genel olarak olumlu karşılanan öneri hakkında görüşlerini dile getirdiler; bu öneri, gelecekteki toplum için hangi fraksiyonun hangi ekonomik düzenlemeyi savunursa savunsun, tüm devrimci anarşist sosyalistleri kucaklayan bir partinin kurulmasını öngörüyor.

1

 Söz konusu yorumlar, bir yandan bazı komünistlerin kolektivistlerle bir araya gelme fikrine karşı bir ölçüde isteksizlik duyduğunu, diğer yandan da, gücünü yitirmiş ve artık çağa uygun olmayan, geçmişte çökmüş örgütler gibi bir yapıyı yeniden canlandırmaya çalıştığımızdan duyulan bir korkuyu ortaya koymaktadır.

Bu konunun iki yönüyle ilgili olarak kısaca açıklamamıza izin verin; gerekirse bu konuyu tekrar ele alacağımıza söz veriyoruz.

Bize göre, tek bir parti içinde anarşist-komünistlerin ve anarşist-kolektivistlerin bir arada var olması, anarşist düşünce ve yöntemin mantıksal ve kaçınılmaz bir sonucudur. Ne anarşist ne de devrimci olan ve her bakımdan sosyalizmin, temsili organlarda koltuk kazanmak için verilen anlamsız ve yozlaştırıcı bir mücadeleden ibaret kalmasını sağlayan belirli bir tür “kolektivist”lerin ortaya çıkması olmasaydı, bu konuda hiçbir zaman şüpheler doğmazdı; İtalya ve Fransa’da – ki bu ülkelerde anarşistlerin büyük çoğunluğu komünisttir – bu kişiler, İtalya’daki hepimizin 1876’dan önce “kolektivizm” kelimesine yüklediğimiz ve İspanyol anarşistlerin çoğunun hâlâ benimsediği anlamın unutulmasını sağlamışlardır.

2

Günümüzde yasama organlarının arasına sızmaya çalışan, yasanın sınırları içinde siyasi reformları ve sözde sosyal yasamayı teşvik eden ve devrim geldiğinde bir “işçi devleti” kurmaya niyetlenen türden kolektivistlerle neredeyse hiç aynı görüşte olamayız. Öte yandan, bir dostumuzun varsaydığı gibi, kolektivizm toplumun tüm servetini, para da dahil olmak üzere, toplumun tüm servetinin insanlar arasında eşit olarak bölüşülmesi ve böylece her bireyin bugün olduğu gibi alım satım yapmaya devam edebilmesi anlamına geliyorsa, bu o kadar saçma bir şey olur ki, varsayalım ki böyle bir şeyin destekçileri bulunsa bile, bunlar sadece birkaç yüzeysel destekçiden ibaret olur ve bunlar devrim için kesinlikle hiçbir fayda veya umut teşkil etmez; bu yüzden onlarla fazla uğraşmak zaman kaybı olur.

Ancak gerçek şu ki, 1876 öncesi Enternasyonal’in eski kolektivizmi ölmemiştir ve büyük olasılıkla, özgür yaşamın pratik gerçekleri onu kesin olarak yanlışladığını kanıtlayana ve burjuva egemenliğinin çöküşünün ardından ortaya çıkacak evrim, herkesi tamamen dayanışma duygusu ve daha büyük ortak yarar üzerine kurulu üstün bir toplumsal bir arada yaşama biçimini benimsemeye yöneltinceye kadar ortadan kalkmayacaktır. Söz konusu kolektivizm, daha önce de belirttiğimiz gibi, İspanyolların büyük çoğunluğu tarafından hâlâ benimsenmektedir ve komünizmin mantığı tarafından sarsılmış olsa da, yerini korumaktadır; bir yandan komünist kampa geçen pek çok kişi varken, diğer yandan hâlâ yeni üyeler kazanmaktadır ve bu durum sadece İspanya ile sınırlı değildir.

O kolektivizm — Bakunin’in propaganda yaptığı günlerden 1876 yılına kadar bizim de benimsediğimiz kolektivizm — (bunu unutmuş olabilecek herkese hatırlatmak isteriz) halk tarafından doğrudan gerçekleştirilen şiddetli toplumsallaştırma anlamına gelir; mevcut her şeyin ortak mülkiyete alınması ve ardından anarşi, yani kendiliğinden evrim yoluyla ulaşılan, her bireyin doğuştan medeniyetin insana sunduğu tüm gelişim imkânlarına erişimi olduğu ve kapsamlı, bütüncül bir bedensel ve entelektüel eğitim aldıktan sonra, kendi seçtiği ortaklarla özgürce çalışabilmesi ve emeğinin tüm ürününden yararlanabilmesi için gerekli hammadde ve emek araçlarının garanti edildiği bir toplum düzenidir.

Biz komünistler bu programı kabul etmiyoruz ve önümüzdeki sayılarda bunun nedenlerini elimizden geldiğince ayrıntılı bir şekilde açıklayacağız; zira bölünmenin olmaması gereken yerlerde birliği sağlamayı amaçlasak da, yine de ideallerimizi hiçbir şekilde sulandırmadan duyurmak zorundayız; ancak bu, bizimle anarşist-kolektivistler arasında var olan büyük yakınlığı görmezden gelmemiz ve bizi birleştiren ve kardeş yapan binlerce bağ varken aramızda bir uçurum olduğunu düşünmemiz için bir neden değildir.

Farklılıkların ve benzerliklerin neler olduğuna bir göz atalım.

content:
Ankara - Yeni Parti Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Özgür Ceylan, partinin dayanışma kampanyasında 26 gün içinde 147 bin 109 bağışçı ve yeni kayıt olan üyelerden toplam 477 milyon 203 bin 229 lira bağış ve aidat desteği sağlandığını açıkladı.

Ceylan sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada şu ifadeleri kullandı:

"Türkiye'nin değişimine inanarak çıktığımız bu yolda, milletimizin güçlü desteği büyüyerek devam ediyor. YENİ Parti'nin dayanışma kampanyasında 26 gün içerisinde 147.109 bağışçımız, yeni kayıt olan üyelerimizle birlikte toplam 477.203.229 TL bağış ve aidat desteği sağlamıştır. Bu katkı, Türkiye'nin yarınlarına duyulan umudun, değişime olan inancın ve ortak geleceğimize sahip çıkma iradesinin ifadesi, Türkiye'nin yarınları için Yeni Parti’ye duyulan güvenin göstergesidir. Milletimizin desteğiyle büyüyen YENİ Parti, Türkiye'de değişime inanan milyonların sesi olmaya devam edecek. Bu büyük yürüyüşe bizimle yol yürüyen tüm vatandaşlarımıza yürekten teşekkür ediyoruz."

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Avoid the pitfalls of liberalism, rethink the world as an anarchist - CANEVA (2026)
content:

Any references to texts available in English had quotations replaced with those from the English versions of the works in question. I apologize for any formatting problems as I tried to stick to that which is in the original text.

Table of contents was excluded due to article format.

Link to original text in French.

Preface from publication in 2026:

This brochure was written in the spring of 2025 amid the debates that followed the July 2024 legislative elections, against a backdrop of a shared observation that a certain kind of confusion was becoming increasingly stifling within anti-authoritarian revolutionary circles. In writing it, we drew on our own observations, informal discussions, and personal analyses, as well as on authors who, at one point or another, shed light on certain topics. We do not necessarily agree with everything they have written. As always, every text requires perspective and critical evaluation.

"What do we mean by ‘liberal excesses’? Since this term has become something of a catch-all and is sometimes used a bit too readily when people want to win an argument, we felt it was important to define what ‘liberal excesses’ are—especially in these confusing times when words seem to have been stripped of their meaning.

Through this pamphlet, we aim to analyze how social-democratic, populist, and even reactionary ideas are finding their way into anarchist and anti-authoritarian circles—and how these ideas go unnoticed because our perspective is so steeped in liberalism.

To combat this and rethink the world from an anarchist perspective, it’s important to identify these signs both in the way we view the world and in our practices.

Luckily, this three-point guide is here to help (but be warned—the last one will surprise you!)"

Anarchism frightens people as much as it fascinates them. Because anarchism has already destabilized states and inspired the assassinations of kings and military leaders; because anarchism is the love of freedom, the dream of emancipation for all, the end of wars and armies, the end of the exploitation of humans by humans, it is that rebellious force that refuses to be confined, constrained, or controlled. A profoundly anti-authoritarian movement that seeks to do away with leaders, the anarchist ideal stands in direct opposition to the system in which we currently live, yet it is by no means impervious to it. Influenced by its era and its environment, anarchism is shaped by various currents and its own internal tensions. However, it must be acknowledged that, in France today, anarchism is no longer on the rise. In the 1990s, Murray Bookchin, an American anarchist, warned: "...the revolutionary and social goals of anarchism are suffering far-reaching erosion to a point where the word anarchy will become part of the chic bourgeois vocabulary of the coming century — naughty, rebellious, insouciant, but deliciously safe."1

In his book Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism: An Unbridgeable Chasm, Bookchin criticized the rise of a kind of “folklorized” anarchism, one stripped of its substance and revolutionary goals, retaining only its aesthetic, spectacular, and individualistic aspects. Indeed, what better way is there to render a movement harmless than to capitalize on its aesthetics while stripping it of its revolutionary aspirations?

Others besides Bookchin have warned against bourgeois excesses or against the forms of oppression that these excesses perpetuated within the movement.

In the 1990s, the African-American anarchist Lorenzo Kom’boa Ervin also pointed out the excesses within the anarchist movement, which was becoming more of a counter-cultural movement composed primarily of white middle-class people than a revolutionary movement.2

In 1936, the anarchist-feminists of Mujeres Libres were fighting and organizing against patriarchal influences and violence within the anarchist movement.

And in 1914, Luigi Fabbri, an Italian anarchist, denounced bourgeois influences on anarchism, particularly those coming from cultural circles: "For these artists and writers, the beauty of the gesture takes the place of social utility, with which they don't concern themselves. So, they've idealized the figure of the anarchist dynamiter because even in its most tragic manifestations it presents undeniable characteristics of …

author: Unknown
title: Nathan Stephens-Griffin & Andrea Brock - Challenging academic complicity in the eco-social destruction inherent in policing: a call for saboteur criminology
content:
Author

: Nathan Stephens-Griffin & Andrea Brock

Title

: Challenging academic complicity in the eco-social destruction inherent in policing: a call for saboteur criminology

Date

: 14 August 2026

Source

: Justice, Power and Resistance Journal • vol XX • no XX • 1–21, Retrieved 23 August 2026 from https://bristoluniversitypressdigital.com/view/journals/jpr/aop/article-10.1332-26352338Y2026D000000077/article-10.1332-26352338Y2026D000000077.xml


Abstract


 Building on insights from critical/green criminology, political ecology, and green anarchism, and drawing on own empirical research (previously reported elsewhere, for example, Brock, 2020; Brock and Dunlap, 2018; Brock et al, 2023; 2026; Stephens-Griffin, 2020; 2021; 2022b) and experience of the policing of ecological resistance and animal liberation, this article makes two core arguments. First, we suggest that policing is not just socially but

ecologically

 harmful, enforcing and defending degradation, extraction, and climate collapse. We illustrate our argument firstly with a case study of policing of (illegal) hunting and hunt sabotage, showing the inadequacy of ‘crime’ as a framework and pointing to the power and politics involved. Mainstream criminology pays insufficient attention to the ecological harms of policing, and reproduces the same statism and anthropocentrism that underlie and legitimise policing. Secondly, to disrupt this complicity of criminology (and academia more widely), we propose ‘saboteur criminology’; an approach that radically rethinks how we engage with police and the criminal justice system, committed to direct action and to supporting and joining those who do ‘whatever it takes’ to stop and reverse ecological harm. Drawing on Aalders and Kioko (2025) and our own work (Brock et al, 2026), we argue for understanding sabotage as

world making

; as legitimate political strategy and important liberation practice. Saboteur criminology makes space within and outside academia, to challenge and disrupt. This involves moving beyond reformist approaches which seek to produce ‘better’ forms of policing, recognising that reforms merely reinforce the legitimacy of these repressive institutions, perpetuating their harms. Instead, saboteur criminology takes seriously abolitionist alternatives for socially and ecologically just futures.


Introduction


 Policing in contemporary (post)colonial Britain is in crisis. The Casey report found the Metropolitan Police to be ‘broken and rotten, suffering collapsing public trust and … guilty of institutional racism, misogyny and homophobia’ (Dodd, 2023: para 1). Discrimination is ‘tolerated … and has become baked into the system’ (Casey, 2023: 16). While not ‘anti-police’, Casey inadvertently supports a view that many have long held: that the sacred principle of ‘policing by consent’ is a myth (Gilmore and Tufail, 2015; Scraton, 2015). Instead, policing is about control and maintaining a particular social order (Neocleous, 2014; 2021), domestically and internationally (Bell, 2013; Elliott-Cooper, 2021). As Cuneen (2023: 170) argues, ‘the foundations of the contemporary institutions of policing are found in the interplay between the centre and the periphery of the colonial experience’, a phenomenon first articulated by Cesaire (1950/2000) as an imperial ‘boomerang’. Violence, corruption, oppression, harm are therefore features, not bugs, of policing. Meanwhile, we witness catastrophic global climate breakdown (IPCC, 2023), biological annihilation, and mass extinction (Ceballos et al, 2017), driven by industrial capitalist expansion, land-use change, extraction, and pollution. We see the collapse of wildlife globally (Bar-On et al, 2018), and an interplay of ecological crises that disproportionately affect those who are already most marginalised – especially in the Global South. Actuaries warn that while three degrees of heating by 2050 could conceivably lead to four billion deaths globally, yet we currently have no realistic plan to avoid this (Laville, 2025). Instead, governments continue to license new oil and gas exploration projects, permit coal mines, build new roads, and expand airports (all ‘legal’), while pumping resources into repressing and criminalising ecological resistance.


 Despite harsh criminalisation, policing, and violence against environmental defenders at the hands of corporations and state actors globally – 2,253 murdered between 2012 and 2024 alone, many more abused, assaulted …
