author: Amira El-Fekki
title: ‘Privacy chaos’: From fraudulent SIM registration to biometric data collection?
content:
A university student was sentenced last week to 25 years in prison, after a SIM card registered in his name was used in a drug-trafficking operation. He and his family have insisted that he never used the SIM card and had not even bought the card in the first place.


His case prompted many to check their own digital profiles and discover that dozens of phone numbers had been registered to their names without their knowledge.


In a wave of anger and concern about digital security, personal data security has become the topic of the hour as the scale of fraudulent phone line registration becomes clear.


The issue has been described as stemming from inadequate checks by mobile operators, who are supposed to demand passport or ID verification in person before allowing customers to establish a mobile phone number.


But permitting phone lines to be issued to customers showing digital copies of passports  leaves the door wide open to fraud, with commentators pointing to dozens of photographed IDs floating around digital platforms and messaging apps ripe for the taking.


The National Telecom Regulatory Authority has referred Egypt’s four mobile operators — Vodafone, Orange, e& and WE — to the Public Prosecution.


The NTRA has also proposed the introduction of biometric identity verification for the registration of new mobile network subscribers.


But why did the NTRA not detect or address the problem before it escalated? How are mobile companies held accountable for the data they collect and retain? 


And while steps have been taken to hold the companies legally responsible, is it enough to get to the root of the problem and ensure that biometric data handed to the NTRA will be handled securely?


The proposed biometric verification comes as Egypt’s personal data protection framework continues to face questions. Unlike data that can be changed, such as passwords, biometric data, such as facial scans, finger prints or eye scans, is permanently linked to the individual, and there is no going back if it is leaked. 


Its use across different services and platforms could also allow for the collection and collation of data belonging to the same person, to build an online data profile of them.


Mada Masr spoke to Mohamed al-Taher, the cofounder of and researcher with Masaar, an organization dedicated to digital rights and freedoms in Egypt, as well as Hassan al-Azhary, a lawyer and researcher with the organization, to unpack the implications of the NTRA’s decision. 


Azhary describes to Mada Masr the NTRA’s regulatory responsibilities and the legal ramifications of citizens discovering mobile lines registered in their names without their knowledge. He also talks us through data protection in Egypt and the loopholes in the regulatory framework and its enforcement. 


And Taher, meanwhile, points to the government’s inclination to begin using biometric data. 


Together, the pair express doubt as to whether biometric identity verification will solve the issue of fraudulent SIM card registration. Instead, they say, it could merely add another dimension to what they dub Egypt’s “privacy chaos.”


The interviews have been lightly edited for clarity.


Mada Masr:

The national regulator, the NTRA, said on Monday that it had referred Egypt’s four mobile operators to the Public Prosecution. Can we expect the referral to bring about better regulation and security in the handling of mobile data?


Hassan al-Azhary:

 The statement acknowledges that the incident is real, meaning there is a problem that concerns citizens complaining that lines have been registered in their names when they didn’t buy those lines.


SIM card distributors used to sell what were called “old” lines: there was this broad, vague and unclear discussion around the issue. This is the first clear and official acknowledgment that there is a problem.


Referring the matter to the Public Prosecution is important because it opens the door more broadly for affected citizens to start bringing lawsuits against the companies, depending on the harm they suffered. Some may seek compensation because they suffered direct harm. Others may seek compensation because they fear that they could be harmed, while some may seek to terminate their contracts. It depends on the extent of the harm each person has suffered.


The third point is that this referral shifts the matter from a question of administrative accountability to one of criminal accountability.

author: Ashley Smith
title: When the Left Distances Itself From Black Lives Matter, Far Right Policies Win
content:
Alec Karakatsanis explains how both Republicans and Democrats have used the backlash to increase the powers of police.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Just six years after millions of people across the country took part in racial justice uprisings after the police murders of George Floyd and Breonna Taylor, politicians and pundits of all stripes — from reactionaries like President Donald Trump to progressives like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — have turned against demands to decrease funding for police. Those demands were popularized over years of organizing from a broad popular movement against decades of unprecedented mass incarceration.

In this interview, Alec Karakatsanis explains the roots of the backlash, how both Republicans and Democrats have used it to increase the powers of police, and why it’s essential to rebuild the movement to fund communities, not cops. Karakatsanis is the founder and executive director of the Civil Rights Corps, an organization that has pioneered landmark litigation challenging systemic injustices in the punishment bureaucracy, author of the book, Copaganda: How the Police and Media Manipulate our News, and publisher of the Copaganda Newsletter.

This interview has been edited for length and clarity.

Ashley Smith: After the police murder of George Floyd, the U.S. exploded in protest, becoming the biggest wave of mass demonstrations in U.S. history with as many as an estimated 26 million people marching across the country. Republicans and Democrats launched a backlash against the movement. What have they argued and done?

Alec Karakatsanis: It’s important to underscore that it’s not just Republicans behind the backlash. It’s a bipartisan establishment assault on the movement that emerged in the decade before 2020. That struggle aimed to reduce the size and power of the punishment bureaucracy, the term I use to describe the institutions the government uses to repress people and the for-profit industries parasitic on them.

That bureaucracy’s role is to control and manage inequality, targeting the most oppressed in our society, from poor people to people of color to people with disabilities and immigrants. It also represses the people involved in social movements that struggle for a more equal society in order to prevent those movements from achieving popular power. Both parties denounced the social movement’s demand to decrease investment in the bureaucracies of repression and increase investment in systems of care.

They used three main tactics. First, they whipped up a frenzy over retail theft and street crimes, harms mainly associated in the public imagination with poor and marginalized people. A lot of this was not founded in facts. For instance, the supposed epidemic of shoplifting turned out to be a lie. It wasn’t going up nationally at all.

They used that fiction to deflect attention from the crimes perpetrated by police, prison guards, bankers, pharmaceutical executives, tax evaders, polluters, and health insurance companies. These cause far more death, injury, and harm to our safety than crimes committed by poor people. For example, FBI figures for all property crimes combined in the United States are dwarfed by estimates of corporate wage theft.

Second, as discussed at length in Copaganda, they claimed that crimes committed by marginalized people are increasing across the country. This fearmongering tricked lots of people into thinking that crime is going up. It’s actually plummeted to historic lows.

Third, liberal and conservative pundits and media claimed that the only solution to their manufactured lie of increasing crime is more investment in the punishment bureaucracy. So, dozens of cities expanded budgets for police and prisons each year since the killing of George Floyd.

Trump in particular has dramatically increased funding of the surveillance state. And he’s deploying its institutions like the National Guard, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to collaborate with the police in city after city to crush marginalized people and political opposition.

How do these two parties carry out the same project in different ways?

title: Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine - Draft Declaration of the Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine
content:
Author

: Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine

Title

: Draft Declaration of the Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine

Date

: 1919

Source

: Nestor Makhno: Anarchy's Cossack


Adopted on October 20, 1919 at a session of the Military Revolutionary Soviet

.


;


 The toiling classes of Ukraine are today confronting events of enormous importance and historic implications. Without doubt, the significance of these events goes beyond the limits of the revolutionary insurgent army’s activity. But, being in the vanguard of the fight in progress, the latter deems it its duty to spell out to the toilers of Ukraine, Russia and the whole world the aims for which it fights, as well as its analysis of recent happenings and the current situation.


 In February-March 1917, Russia and Ukraine experienced the

First Revolution,

 which led to the fall of Tsarist autocracy and brought about the advent of a State political power comprised at first of personages from the big industrial bourgeoisie and then of representatives of the small and medium bourgeoisie. Neither of those two governments proved stable. Eight months were enough for the revolutionary masses to overthrow these authorities which had nothing in common with the interests and aspirations of toilers.


 As early as July 1917, the necessity of a

Second Revolution

 was apparent. This took place at the end of October and paved the way for seizure of State power by the Bolshevik Social Democrat party which looked upon itself as representing the revolutionary proletariat and poor peasantry or, to put it another way, the social revolution. That party was very soon waging an ongoing campaign against all competing parties with an eye to arrogating power to itself. Since its watchwords coincided with the aspirations of the toiling masses, the latter threw their weight behind it when the crucial time came. And so this eight month period of government by the bourgeoisie in coalition and of rivalry between the differing political parties ended in the Bolshevik Party’s taking power.


 However it very quickly became apparent that this party ad this State power — just like any party and all State power — functioned only for themselves and turned out to be utterly powerless to achieve the great objectives of the social revolution: by virtue of that very fact they were a hindrance to the free creative activity of the. toiling masses who alone were capable of tackling this task. It is self-evident that in controlling the whole of economic and social life, any State power inevitably gives rise to new political and economic privileges and undermines the very foundations of social revolution.


 The Bolshevik-Communist Party’s inability to offer an authentic avenue of struggle for socialism quite naturally led to discontent, disappointment and bitterness among the toiling masses. The disorganized condition of economic life, the consequence of a bad agrarian policy led to serious disturbances in the countryside. The Bolshevik authorities have succeeded, however, in organizing in Russia a mighty State machine and a compliant army which it uses as its predecessors did, to stamp on any manifestation of popular discontent and resistance.


In Ukraine the situation is otherwise.


 Before making the acquaintance of the Bolshevik authorities, Ukraine was occupied by the Austro-Germans who installed their vassal, the hetman Skoropadsky there. They were replaced by the power of Petliura. The excesses of these authorities triggered an explosion of outrage from the people and a wholesale rejection of the very idea of State power, which assumed the form of a mighty popular insurgent movement, driven by an authentically revolutionary anti-party and anti-authoritarian mentality. In a series of engagements after the departure of the Austro-Germans, revolutionary insurgents purged Ukraine of supporters of the hetman and of Petliura: the Bolshevik-Communist authorities seized upon this to arrive and ensconce themselves in the spring of 1919, bringing disappointment very quickly in their wake. Within a few months, the discontent and hostility of the toiling masses of town and above all of countryside was made violently manifest. Large regions, such as the provinces of Ekaterinoslav and Tavrida, began to drift more and more unmistakably towards economic and social self-organization on a basis of animosity towards parties and State power. author: Hanieh Jodat
title: We’re Half a Year Into Trump’s War on Iran. Congress Has Tools to End It.
content:
The clash over whether the US has a functioning constitutional process for starting and ending wars is coming to a head.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran is entering its seventh month after a series of attempts at diplomatic negotiations moderated by Pakistan and other countries in the region. The U.S has embroiled itself in a conflict without a clear exit strategy, and Iran has shown no interest in bending under President Donald Trump’s pressure. As Washington and Tehran continue this agonizing yo-yo of threats, the growing reported number of casualties feel heavy. More than 3,400 Iranians have reportedly been killed, while over 26,000 have been wounded, including at least 4,000 women and more than 1,600 children. On the American side, the Pentagon currently reports that 14 U.S. service members have been killed and more than 700 wounded. However, one Department of Defense (DOD) official accused the Pentagon of “an accounting trick” in order to misrepresent the true casualty figures.

By now it has become obvious that Benjamin Netanyahu played a key role in convincing Trump to start this war of choice, after decades of pushing the United States to attack Iran. In recent years, Israel’s lobby, in collaboration with opposition leaders from the Iranian diaspora — including the son of Iran’s late Shah Reza Pahlavi and his monarchist advisors — and a group of hawkish American officials pushed the U.S. to the brink of this war.

Until recently, those attempts were unsuccessful — that is, until they finally found a U.S. president who would risk a strategic disaster and economic collapse for one of the most quickly unpopular wars in U.S. history. But after half a year of war, the question is no longer how we arrived at this war, but more so how Congress might limit the executive branch and force an end to the military hostilities.

Poll after poll reveals that people in the U.S. are increasingly questioning the motivation and cost of the war. After decades of U.S. military interventions across the Middle East and West Asia that have cost trillions of dollars without any sign of success, Americans have expressed their exhaustion with the financial and human toll of another conflict. A Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted in late July found that only 33 percent of people in the U.S. supported the war with Iran, the lowest level of support measured since the conflict began. Sixty-nine percent said President Trump had failed to explain the objectives of the military operation in Iran clearly.

Diplomacy and negotiations between the U.S. and Iran have repeatedly faltered since Trump entered office for the first time and pulled out of a landmark nuclear deal engineered by the Obama administration. The possibility of a lasting political settlement remains buried beneath the weight of the bombs dropped on civilians, sanctions, military threats, and political calculation. And the consequences of the war of choice with Iran are not confined to the Middle East. Rising food and energy prices, inflation, regular attacks on U.S. bases with an unknown number of U.S. casualties, and the uncertainty over the war’s future have shifted the way both Americans and the rest of the world view U.S. recklessness. And the frustration has only gotten worse; by August, roughly two-thirds of people in the U.S. opposed the war outright, according to Reuters polling.

The question now is whether the United States has a functioning and democratic constitutional process for deciding when a war begins, how long it continues, and when it ends.

In the face of clear American opposition to the war, the question now is whether the United States has a functioning and democratic constitutional process for deciding when a war begins, how long it continues, and when it ends.

While Trump and his war cabinet have swung back and forth between the promise of diplomacy and peace or the threats of further military escalation, Congress has unsuccessfully attempted several times to reassert its constitutional authority. Only Congress has the power to declare war, and the 1973 War Powers Resolution gives the president a 60-day clock to terminate hostilities without congressional approval. The president has now blown through that deadline — bringing about several constitutional questions for lawmakers.

author: Maria Martha Bruno
title: Facebook não barra anúncios com desinformação sobre eleições brasileiras
content:
Investigamos o que importa para os brasileiros além do que passa na campanha eleitoral. Leia mais reportagens como essa clicando

aqui

.


Um experimento da Anistia Internacional mostrou que as medidas da Meta não estão sendo suficientes para combater a desinformação no Facebook na campanha eleitoral brasileira. A ONG internacional submeteu 14 anúncios com conteúdo desinformativo sobre as eleições brasileiras e um neutro. Oito foram aceitos, enquanto os sete restantes (incluindo o neutro) foram sinalizados para verificação de identidade por parecerem relacionados a uma questão social, eleição ou política, em vez de serem rejeitados especificamente por conterem desinformação eleitoral. Nenhum deles foi postado publicamente, portanto, os usuários não tiveram contato com o conteúdo.


Os 14 anúncios desinformativos do experimento da Anistia Internacional incluíam alegações de que as eleições de outubro deste ano seriam fraudadas e pedidos de intervenção militar. Com exceção do anúncio neutro, os 14 violaram as próprias

políticas da Meta

 sobre desinformação, especificamente a seção relacionada à interferência na votação ou no comparecimento dos eleitores. A definição de desinformação da Meta inclui “conteúdo com potencial para interferir em processos políticos”.


Três de quatro anúncios que pediam intervenção militar foram aprovados. Um deles dizia: “Precisamos de uma revolução militar. Não vote nas eleições e os militares vão tomar o poder se houver menos de 50% de comparecimento nas urnas”.


O anúncio neutro foi incluído pela Anistia para testar a exigência de verificação de identidade feita pela Meta para a postagem de quaisquer conteúdos relacionados a eleições.


Segundo a ONG, a conta usada para o teste não concluiu o processo de verificação de identidade para manter o perfil mais neutro, de modo a evitar influência do algoritmo. Portanto, não há como saber se, caso fosse feita a verificação de identidade da conta, os anúncios seriam aceitos ou não.


Em 2025, o Facebook tinha 109,2 milhões de usuários no Brasil, segundo a

plataforma

 de dados Statista; já o Instagram é

mais popular

 e contava com 146 milhões de contas no mesmo ano. Os anúncios podem circular entre as plataformas.


Pouco tempo para as novas regras


De acordo com a descrição do experimento da Anistia Internacional, os anúncios refletiam “três táticas frequentemente utilizadas por políticos e candidatos para apoiar práticas autoritárias”: “deslegitimação eleitoral”, com conteúdos que minam a confiança no sistema de votação brasileiro e nos resultados; “construção do inimigo”, colocando adversários políticos e a Justiça como ameaças; e “autoritarismo com foco na segurança pública”, que traz o uso da força, da intervenção militar ou de um líder forte como respostas necessárias ao crime.


Anúncio-teste do experimento da Anistia Internacional no Facebook


“Em vez de zelar pela participação eleitoral e pelo acesso à informação precisa, estes sistemas de moderação correm o risco de aprovar conteúdo nocivo [ao processo eleitoral]”, diz Ummar Bashir, pesquisador e consultor da Anistia para Inteligência Artificial e Direitos Humanos.


Os anúncios foram enviados de fora do Brasil, do escritório da Anistia em Londres, sem uso de VPN, recurso que poderia simular que o conteúdo fora postado em território nacional. Para a ONG, a aprovação é preocupante porque mostra “vulnerabilidades passíveis de exploração por atores nacionais ou estrangeiros que busquem influenciar processos eleitorais”.


A Meta não respondeu aos questionamentos da ONG sobre as falhas de moderação que permitiram ao Facebook aceitar os anúncios enganosos. Questionada pela Pública, a Meta Brasil também não mandou posicionamento.


Em seu site institucional, a empresa

informa

 que usa inteligência artificial para identificar, nos anúncios, conteúdos que possam violar suas políticas. Em seguida, segundo a empresa, o conteúdo é avaliado automaticamente ou por revisores humanos e, quando uma violação é confirmada, são aplicadas medidas como remoção, restrição ou rejeição dos anúncios, de acordo com os Padrões da Comunidade da Meta. Este conjunto de regras, de acordo com a companhia, “é baseado no

feedback

 de usuários e especialistas em tecnologia, segurança pública e direitos humanos”.


Em 2025, dias antes da posse do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, o CEO da Meta, Mark Zuckerberg,

anunciou

 uma mudança drástica nas políticas de moderação de conteúdo e checagem de …

author: webadmin
title: Leveret Hunting Underway Across The Country
content:
The recent conviction of packs such as the Stowe School Beagles, the Pipewell Foot Beagles and the Dorset & Somerset Bassets have highlighted the ongoing issue of illegal hare hunting.


But far from being deterred by their paltry fines, these and other packs will shortly be beginning their programme of illegal leveret hunting.


Low key: beaglers head out into the killing fields.


What Is Leveret Hunting?


As with fox hunting, beagles must be trained to hunt and kill their quarry. Leverets – young hares – present an easy target for the new and inexperienced hounds. The pack of beagles are taken to open fields and encouraged to search for hares and leverets. Unlike in main season hunting, the hunters do not want a long chase. They will even turn escaping leverets back towards the hounds to ensure a quick kill.


Leveret hunting usually takes place in September and early October but can start as soon as crops are cleared. The hunters meet early in the morning – from 6am onwards – because that is when the scent is best for new, inexperienced hounds and because the countryside is very quiet.


The Sandhurst & Aldershot Beagles keep a low profile.


“The Hare Hunters Equivalent of Cub Hunting”


Fox hunters have tried to rebrand their cub hunting as ’autumn’ hunting. However, beaglers recognise that hunting young hares is so horrendous that they simply deny it exists. A brief look at their literature – from the days when they were a little more open and honest – reveals otherwise:


“…young hounds should be allowed to get away on a well-grown leveret rather than an old, experienced hare.” –

‘Early Hunting Lessons’ chapter in ‘Beagling’ by J.C. Jeremy Hobson.


“…hounds are taken out in the early morning or late afternoon. This is for the hare hunters equivalent of cub hunting; some masters, in fact, call the period “leveret hunting.” –

‘Hunts and Countries’ chapter in ‘Beaglers’ by Jack Ivester Lloyd


“In order to get young hounds trained to hunt they start hunting in the very early morning or evening once the harvest is clear usually in August or September. They are accompanied only by invitation of the Master for this beagling equivalent of the foxhunter’s cub-hunting.” –

An Introduction To Beagling by Iain Clarke.


Typical leveret hunt meet: note hound trailer to the left.


What does it look like?


Obviously, a pack of small beagle hounds in the middle of a field is a give-away. There will be few people present as only the most trusted supporters are invited to attend these secret hunts. Don’t expect the hunters to be in uniform – they don’t usually wear this until the main season.


Stowe School Beaglers congratulate each other after tearing a hare to pieces.


What should I do if I see a suspected leveret hunt?


If it is safe to do so, filming the hunters will often be enough to stop them in their tracks. Try to film key individuals and their vehicles. Please then pass this information to the Hunt Saboteurs Association tip-off line on:

07443 148426

.


Hunting leverets with dogs is illegal so, if you believe a crime is in progress, call the police straight away.

author: A.N.A.
title: [Itália] Antiespecismo, veganismo e crise climática
content:
O verão que estamos vivendo está nos mostrando de forma tremendamente tangível o quanto nossas atividades destrutivas estão impactando o clima terrestre. Não há parte do mundo que não esteja sofrendo com desconfortos, ou mesmo verdadeiros desastres, climáticos. Em nosso país, ondas de calor tropical se sucedem, causando cada vez mais incêndios (quando não são criminosos), eventos climáticos extremos e fazendo diminuir assustadoramente o nível da água dos rios e lagos.


Nossa casa comum, a Terra, está doente e o vírus que a infectou somos nós.

 Um conceito mais que banal e totalmente evidente. Apesar de tudo isso, no âmbito antiespecista e vegano, este assunto tão dramaticamente urgente quase nunca é abordado. No entanto, toda vez que uma floresta pega fogo, morrem milhões de Animais, assim como também ocorre com deslizamentos, enxurradas, alagamentos, transbordamentos, longos períodos de seca e tempestades. As zonas climáticas estão mudando rapidamente e isso também significa o desaparecimento de muitas espécies animais que não conseguirão mais se adaptar ao novo clima. Como é que não paramos para refletir sobre tudo isso?


A 

Questão Animal

 diz respeito a todas as áreas da ação humana, a todas as suas implicações e consequências, portanto, também e principalmente, aos desastres climáticos que estamos causando com a poluição, o enorme desperdício de energia, as atividades extrativistas, a poluição, a exploração dos ecossistemas e a antropização e destruição dos habitats naturais. Não considerar tudo isso sob uma ótica antiespecista e vegana, para tentar combater este fenômeno gravíssimo e complexo que produzimos diretamente, é simplesmente uma loucura.


Se a nossa função, enquanto pessoas humanas antiespecistas, é retirar os Animais da exploração humana e, por fim, chegar à tão almejada libertação, não podemos nos eximir de compreender o quanto a crise climática está impactando de forma devastadora a vida dos seres vivos terrestres.


Cada vez mais, a mídia nos mostra imagens de rios secos; toda vez que um rio desaparece, deixando apenas um leito vazio e seco, desaparecem também milhões de Animais, plantas, muitos outros organismos vivos que o habitavam e outros que dependiam de sua presença: quando um rio morre, com ele morre um mundo inteiro, é um grande e vital amigo que se foi. Não podemos ser tão estúpidos e insensíveis a ponto de não compreender isso.


Temos o dever e a urgência de incluir no leque de reflexões e intervenções do nosso ativismo conceitos básicos de ecologia: certamente não aquela especista, antropocêntrica e superficial que nos é empurrada diariamente, mas a 

ecologia profunda

 não antropocêntrica, útil para nos ajudar finalmente a entender o quão frágil e ameaçada está a rede da vida na Terra.


Adriano Fragano

https://www.manifestoantispecista.org/web/antispecismo-veganismo-e-crisi-climatica/

title: 1,500 mink escape from Oregon farm after fence is cut open reportedly by extremist animal rights group
content:
Roughly 1,500 mink escaped an Oregon farm after a hole was cut in a fence — with an extremist animal rights group linking themselves to the plot to free the creatures, according to authorities and reports.

The scores of mink were intentionally let loose from Cascade Farm in Turner late last Wednesday night as the farm’s manager, his wife, children, and other employees were sleeping, KOIN reported.

The suspected intruders cut a hole in a chain-link fence enclosure, allowing the mink to roam free, the local outlet said.

The Animal Liberation Front — a decentralized group of international animal rights advocates labeled as extremists by the FBI — appears to have taken responsibility for the break-in, the outlet reported.

In a press release, the radical group said they have yet to receive an “anonymous communique” officially taking credit for the action.

But Jerry Vlasak, a spokesperson for the North American Animal Liberation Front, told the outlet that the mink escape plot was consistent with their group’s actions and that communiques from activists claiming responsibility are not always sent.

The farm owners have since recovered about 90% of the cute, semiaquatic mammals, the Marion County Sheriff’s Office told the outlet.

“This wasn’t activism. It was a criminal act against a legally operated, certified farm,” Challis Hobbs, Executive Director of Fur Commission USA, an organization that represents mink farmers including Cascade Farm, told the outlet.

“The farm manager and his wife and children live on this property, along with other employees and their families,” he said. “It’s deeply unsettling to have people cut through a fence in the middle of the night with children sleeping just steps away.”

Cascade Farm raises mink legally for pelts and is Humane Care Certified. Any of the mink that aren’t recovered within 24 to 48 hours also face risk of starvation and death, Fur Commission USA added.

The animal activists, however, claimed the mink would be subjected to “egregiously cruel and violent” treatment in captivity.

“The animals liberated last night have a fighting chance at life; they faced a 100 percent death rate if they stayed on the farm,” the Animal Liberation Front wrote in a statement.

The group previously claimed responsibility for cutting open a fence at Olsen Fur Farm in Wisconsin in 2023, allowing about 3,000 mink to escape, CBS reported.

Fleischindustrie

 gezüchtet und wegen ihres Fleisches getötet werden. 


Sie können nicht dabei zusehen, wie Schweine und andere Tiere leiden? Jährlich werden rund 44 Millionen Schweine getötet  


Schweine sind hochintelligente Tiere, die über komplexe Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein bemerkenswertes Gedächtnis verfügen. Diese neugierigen, sozialen Tiere lieben es, Zeit mit ihren Lieben zu verbringen, zu spielen, sich zu sonnen und die Welt um sich herum zu erkunden. Wie Menschen und andere Tiere können auch Schweine Schmerz und Angst empfinden – dennoch wurden im Jahr 2025 allein in Deutschland 44,9 Millionen Schweine getötet. [1]  


In der industriellen 

Tierhaltung

 verbringen Schweine meist ihr gesamtes Leben in beengten, schmutzigen Ställen, wo sie keine Nester für ihre Kinder bauen, kaum gesunde soziale Kontakte zu anderen knüpfen oder sich im Schlamm wälzen können. 


Schweinehaltung: Enge Kastenstände, Verstümmelungen und qualvolle Transporte  


Landwirt:innen trennen Ferkel und Mütter wenige Wochen nach ihrer Geburt und unterziehen sie qualvollen 

Verstümmelungen

 wie Schwanzkupieren oder Zähnekürzen ohne Betäubung. Die jungen Schweine verbringen dann ihr kurzes Leben in überfüllten Ställen auf harten Spaltenböden, teilweise inmitten ihrer eigenen Exkremente – und manchmal auch zwischen den toten Körpern anderer Schweine, denn viele Tiere überleben diese Strapazen nicht. 


Muttertiere verbringen einen großen Teil ihres Lebens in Kastenständen, die so klein sind, dass sie sich nicht einmal umdrehen können. Sie werden immer wieder künstlich befruchtet, bis ihr Körper erschöpft ist – dann werden sie im 

Schlachthof

Verletzte und gestresste Schweine während eines Tiertransportes – vermutlich auf dem Weg ins Schlachthaus.


Die Produktion von Fleisch ist nie „human“ 


Auch wenn irreführende 

Tierwohl-Labels

 anderes behaupten, gibt es keine Möglichkeit, jemanden „human” auszubeuten und zu töten. Egal, ob bio oder von „Bäuer:innen von nebenan“ – Schweine leiden immer in der Fleischproduktion. Labels sind lediglich dazu da, das Gewissen von Konsument:innen zu beruhigen, denn die Haltung der Tiere unterscheidet sich nur minimal von der konventionellen Tierhaltung. In allen Haltungsformen werden die Tiere am Ende im Schlachthof getötet.

title: Der Bauernverband gibt der Ernährungsinitiative recht
content:
Am 27. September 2026 können die Stimmberechtigten der Schweiz über die Ernährungsinitiative abstimmen.


Hier meine persönliche Meinung zu dieser Initiative: diese Initiative möchte, dass der Anteil in der Schweiz produzierter und konsumierter pflanzlicher Lebensmittel steigt und schlägt vor, über die Förderung des Anbaus und des Konsums solcher Lebensmittel einen Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% anzustreben.


Das ist ein sinnvolles Anliegen, das sich für eine ressourceneffizientere und somit nachhaltigere Landwirtschaft einsetzt: aktuell wird in der Schweiz auf Ackerland viel Tierfutter angebaut in Form von Futtermais, Futtergetreide und Futterrüben. Es wäre viel sinnvoller und effizienter auf diesen Flächen stattdessen Lebensmittel für die menschliche Ernährung anzubauen. Erst recht da wir in der Schweiz eine Unterversorgung haben an Getreide und Leguminosen für die menschliche Ernährung und diese im grossen Stil importieren, während bei tierischen Produkten teilweise gar grosse Mengen exportiert werden müssen, weil in der Schweiz die Nachfrage nicht genügt.


Obwohl das Anliegen der Initiative vernünftig und nachhaltig ist, macht die Gegnerschaft schon seit geraumer Zeit mit absurden Parolen wie «Nein zum Veganzwang!» Stimmung gegen diese Initiative. Und sie macht das so erfolgreich, dass inzwischen sogar der Umweltverband Pro Natura, welcher die Initiative anfangs unterstützte, wohl aus Angst vor einem Imageschaden die Nein-Parole beschlossen hat. Ein sehr bemerkenswerter Vorgang bei einem ökologischen Anliegen.


Trotz der reisserischen Parolen lohnt es sich, die Argumente der Gegnerschaft genauer anzuschauen: Unter dem Titel vom «Veganzwang» argumentiert der Bauernverband, dass ein Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% nur durch eine vegane oder nahezu vegane Ernährung möglich wäre. Ja, richtig gelesen: der Bauernverband sagt, dass durch vegane Ernährung ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Das ist eine wilde 180°-Wende zu pflanzenbasierter Ernährung: von Verteidiger:innen der Nutztierhaltung hiess es bis anhin fast durchs Band, dass vegane Ernährung in der Schweiz keinen Sinn mache, da aufgrund des Grünlandes in der Schweiz bei einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Ernährung der Selbstversorgungsgrad sinken würde. Nun bestätigt also der Bauernverband, dass mit einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Lebensmittel ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Er bestätigt damit auch, dass die aktuelle Schweizer Landwirtschaft in hohem Mass Ressourcenverschwendung betreibt. Und er gibt damit inhaltlich auch der Initiative Recht: mit mehr pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln wäre ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad und eine ressourceneffizientere Landwirtschaft möglich.


Das einzige, was der Bauernverband gegen die Initiative sagt, ist also, dass er das nicht möchte. Er möchte lieber die aktuellen verschwenderischen landwirtschaftlichen Förderstrukturen beibehalten, anstatt den Anbau von pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln zu fördern, die nachhaltiger wären und für die es in der Schweiz tatsächlich einen Bedarf und eine Nachfrage gäbe.


Dass der Bauernverband trotz dem offenen Eingestehen, dass ihre Landwirtschaft nicht nachhaltig ist, die Stimmung so prägen kann, dass selbst Pro Natura einknickt, sollte zu denken geben. Und zeigt meiner Meinung nach zwei Dinge: erstens welche Diskursmacht der eng mit den Wirtschaftsverbänden verbundene Bauernverband bei Landwirtschaftsthemen bis weit in linke und ökologische Kreise hinein hat. Und zweitens welch überhöhte, romantisierte und unantastbare Stellung die Tierhaltung und insbesondere die Rinderhaltung in der Schweizer Öffentlichkeit hat.


Darum umso dringender: JA am 27.9.26 zur Ernährungsinitiative!


Jann Krättli, Biohof Tannacker, Rechthalten

title: Découverte macabre : 300 cochons morts dans un élevage Eureden
content:
L214 publie des images d'un élevage porcin situé à Hénon et à Saint-Carreuc, dans les Côtes-d'Armor. L'exploitation, liée à la coopérative Eureden et récemment présentée comme un modèle d'avenir pour l'élevage porcin, révèle une situation catastrophique : plus de 300 cadavres de cochons et de porcelets (en décomposition avancée, corps momifiés ou déjà à l’état de squelettes). Un enfer où des cochons vivants se trouvent encore au milieu des morts. Pour L214, il s'agit de l'un des pires cas d'abandon d'animaux documentés par l'association. L'association porte plainte pour mauvais traitements et abandon d'animaux auprès du procureur de la République du tribunal judiciaire de Saint-Brieuc, signale les faits aux services de la préfecture des Côtes-d'Armor et demande au préfet la fermeture immédiate de l'exploitation.

Cette enquête montre 300 cadavres de cochons abandonnés dans les bâtiments d'un élevage situés dans les Côtes-d'Armor (Bretagne). Certains corps sont momifiés, d'autres sont réduits à l'état de squelettes. Des animaux sont morts depuis plusieurs semaines, certains depuis plusieurs mois. Il s'agit de l'un des pires cas d'abandon d'animaux documentés par l'association.

Quelques semaines avant la découverte de ces cadavres, cet élevage faisait l'objet d'une importante communication de la coopérative agro-industrielle Eureden. Le 19 juin 2026, une journée portes ouvertes y a réuni 550 personnes autour d'un des bâtiments, neuf et sans animaux, présenté comme l'avenir de l'élevage porcin, à la pointe de l'innovation et du « bien-être animal ». Derrière ces éléments de langage, les animaux sont pris au piège dans des bâtiment fermés privés de leurs besoins les plus fondamentaux, et laissés sans soin.

Nous demandons à Monsieur le préfet :

la fermeture immédiate de cet élevage ;

la mise à l'abri des animaux encore vivants ;

l'interdiction pour l'exploitant de détenir ou d'exercer une activité auprès d'animaux.

title: Hunting: It’s No Child’s Play
content:
In 2023, the UN released General Comment No. 26. This document updates the famous UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. It explicitly states children must be kept safe from witnessing violence, including physical or psychological harm inflicted on animals. Yet every week across the UK children are taken out to participate in hunting, where they will be exposed to horrific levels of animal cruelty.


A small child is witness to a fox being dug out and thrown to waiting hounds.


On Boxing Day 2020 the Avon Vale Hunt were filmed digging out a fox and throwing her to waiting hounds. Tom Ledbury, the terrierman for this hunt, was sentenced to a 12-month community order for his role in this sickening act. Something equally horrifying is how a small child was present throughout the dig out.


Recent HSA articles have exposed the extent of indoctrination of children into the world of hunting. One of the most recent exposes is the

Stowe Beagles

 recent conviction for killing a hare. Kennel huntsman Philip Kennedy was convicted for the offence but drone footage shows students from Stowe School gloating and celebrating while the hare is mauled by hounds.


Is it part of Stowe Schools curriculum to encourage students to participate in the tearing apart of wildlife?


In November 2025 Lake District Hunt Sabs caught the horrifying moment the

Coniston Foxhounds

 dug out a fox with the use of a terrier, and carried her to waiting hounds. What is apparent from the footage is how co-ordinated the dig out was, a clear indication that this is a regular occurrence. What is also evident are the ages of some of the participants. While older members of the group are participating in the dig out, younger members are watching closely, enthusiastically waiting to get involved, with one of them being handed the terrified fox who he then carries and throws to hounds.


This youth gleefully grabbed the fox by the scruff of her neck and threw her to hounds.


As we know, animal cruelty is just one part of a hunt, there is much more anti-social behaviour and illegal activity that comes with it and this doesn’t stop just because a hunt is professing to have a children’s meet.


In February this year West Midlands Hunt Saboteurs reported of road chaos and violence at a Warwickshire Hunt children’s meet. While hunting in Little Kineton gamekeeper Michael Collins physically assaulted a saboteur. This was followed by hunt master Olivia Forsyth purposely blocking the busy B4455 while she ranted and raved, before eventually being moved on by police.


What a great example to set for children.


It’s not just fox and hare hunting that indoctrinates children; they are exposed to animal cruelty at all blood sports. Just this weekend, at the Dove Valley Mink Hounds, children as young as 11 were present, with one as young as 14 carrying a T-bar and a shovel, ready and waiting to participate in the tormenting of mink and otters.


What a wonderful way to spend the summer holidays, learning how to terrorise and abuse the local wildlife.


As the UN states, children should be kept safe from witnessing all forms of violence, including that inflicted upon animals. What the above examples show are that children are not only witnessing this violence, they are active participants from a very young age, being taught that this is acceptable and being encouraged to be complicit in breaking the law.


The problem is the adults teaching them were subject to the same indoctrination and so a cycle has been formed. A cycle of barbaric violence and law breaking which is dressed up as ‘tradition.’ There are some things that should not be passed onto children and blood sports is one of them.

Hunting: It’s No Child’s Play

Hunt Saboteurs Association

title: ‘They’re still there’: Activists warn of more mink raids after break-in at Oregon farm
content:
PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — After a late-night break-in last week led to the escape of 1,500 mink from an Oregon farm, some animal rights activists say more intrusions could be on the way.

The Animal Liberation Front, a decentralized group of extremist animal rights advocates known for sabotage, vandalism and even arson, has claimed responsibility in a press release shared on its website for the Aug. 13 break-in at Cascade Farms of Oregon mink farm in Turner, Oregon.

That claim has been unconfirmed by officials. The Federal Bureau of Investigation’s Portland office declined to comment on whether it is investigating the break-in.

The Marion County Sheriff’s Office said there have been no arrests related to the case, and they have no information indicating the ALF’s involvement.

The owner of Cascade Farms of Oregon, Randy Lucas, did not respond to multiple phone calls seeking comment about the break-in. Cascade Farms was established by Lucas’ father, John Lucas, as a meat business and ranch in 1980. The meat business has since closed, and John Lucas passed away, but the ranch remains in business.

But Joseph Buddenberg, a former member of the Animal Liberation Front, said the break-in at Cascade Farm in Turner is consistent with an ALF action. Jerry Vlasak from the North American Animal Liberation press office, which represents the ALF in North America, also said it was consistent with an ALF action but has not received an anonymous communique taking credit for the action. Vlasak also said communiques are often submitted by activists days or even weeks after an event but sometimes aren’t sent at all.

“There have been over 100 fur farm raids in the United States dating back to the 1990s,” Buddenberg said. “Cutting the fences, opening cages, and destroying breeding records have been tactics historically utilized by the ALF.”

Buddenberg pleaded guilty in 2016 to conspiracy to violate the Animal Enterprise Terrorism Act after he and a partner were accused of terrorizing the fur industry during cross-country road trips. He has since completed his sentence and said he hopes speaking out can help people understand why activists go to such extreme lengths.

“Every summer we see activists break in to free mink from farms,” he said. “Every November, they’re pelted.”

Farmed mink are typically bred and raised early in the year until around November, when they’re harvested for their pelts, which are sold for luxury fur apparel and other items. The industry generated $28.1 million in pelts in 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Mink Survey.

Humanely certified operations use carbon monoxide gas, which immediately renders them unconscious and ensures they die quickly and without pain, according to the trade organization Fur Commission USA. The group estimates there are approximately 275 mink farms in 23 states across the U.S., and has said mink that are released often don’t survive.

“If they stayed on the farm, they’d have a 100% death rate,” he said. “Release at least gives them a chance at survival. Fur farmers should definitely expect to see more of this before November.”

Despite his previous felony conviction and time served, Buddenberg remains steadfast in his views.

“Opening cages and freeing these animals is the most compassionate thing you can do,” he said. “My mind hasn’t changed on that at all.”

Oregon’s mink farming industry is a shadow of what it once was. Data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture show Oregon had 37 mink farms in 1978. A decade later, in 1998, that number dropped to 30. By 2006, there were only 18 mink farms in Oregon. Since then, the USDA has stopped including the number of ranches in its reports. Some estimates say Oregon currently has around 11 mink farms. Others, including Buddenberg, estimate there are only about five left in the state, including Cascade.

“Actions like this have a history of closing fur farms,” Buddenberg said. “My hope is that this farm will close. Actions like this are very effective.”

The ALF claimed responsibility for multiple mink farm break-ins in Oregon in 2008, according to several reports published in the Oregonian and the Daily Astorian. They included a break-in at Jefferson Mink Farm in Jefferson, a break-in at S&N Fur Farm in Scio, and a break-in at Ylipelto’s Fur Farm in Astoria. In all three cases, fencing around the farm was cut, and the mink were released into the wild.

title: Hayden Panettiere: Letzte PETA-Kampagne gegen Delfinarien
content:
Nur wenige Wochen vor ihrem Tod setzte sich Schauspielerin Hayden Panettiere gemeinsam mit PETA USA im Rahmen einer eindringlichen Kampagne gegen 

Delfinarien

 und 

Meeresparks

 wie SeaWorld ein. Für das Motiv legte sie sich in eine Badewanne, um auf Platzmangel aufmerksam zu machen, unter dem Delfine in Gefangenschaft leiden. 


PETA USA veröffentlicht die Kampagne im August 2026 in Erinnerung an Panettiere und ihren langjährigen Einsatz für Meeressäuger. Ihre zentrale Botschaft: Menschen sollten keine Tickets für Einrichtungen kaufen, die 

Delfine

 in kleinen Becken gefangen halten und zu touristischen Attraktionen degradieren. 


Hayden Panettiere zeigt, wie wenig Platz Delfine in Gefangenschaft haben 


In dem Kampagnenvideo verdeutlicht Panettiere, was Delfinen in Gefangenschaft genommen wird:  


In ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum können sie mit ihren Familien zusammenleben, große Distanzen zurücklegen, tief tauchen und sich frei im Meer bewegen. 


In Delfinarien dagegen sind die Tiere auf kleine Becken oder flache Lagunen beschränkt. 


Nicht nur in den USA werden Hunderte Delfine in solchen Anlagen gehalten. Dort werden sie beispielsweise gezwungen, 

„Kunststücke“ vorzuführen

 oder werden für 

touristische Begegnungen

 missbraucht, bei denen fremde Menschen sie immer wieder anfassen. Die Delfine haben dabei keine Möglichkeit, sich zurückzuziehen. 


Viele der heute in Gefangenschaft lebenden Delfine wurden vor Jahrzehnten aus dem Meer entrissen und von ihren Familien getrennt. Andere wurden bereits in Gefangenschaft geboren und konnten nie frei im offenen Ozean schwimmen. 


Panettiere macht in dem Video deutlich, welche Folgen diese Gefangenschaft für die Tiere haben kann, und fordert die Öffentlichkeit dazu auf, keine Meeresparks mit Delfinhaltung zu besuchen. 


Vow today to never go to a marine park that keeps dolphins in extreme captivity. Together, we can end this cruelty.

Hayden Panettiere


Sie ruft dazu auf, keine Meeresparks zu besuchen, die Delfine unter solch grausamen Bedingungen gefangen halten, und diese Tierquälerei gemeinsam zu beenden. 


Hayden Panettieres langjähriger Einsatz für Delfine 


Die Kampagne war nicht Panettieres erster Einsatz für Delfine und andere Meeressäuger. Bereits 2007 paddelte die damals 18-Jährige vor 

Taiji in Japan

 ins Wasser und stellte sich Delfinjäger:innen entgegen. Die Ereignisse rund um die dortige Delfinjagd wurden später auch im Oscar-prämierten Dokumentarfilm 

The Cove

 thematisiert. 


2015 unterstützte Panettiere zudem eine juristische Stellungnahme gegen die geplante Einfuhr von 18 wild gefangenen Belugas aus Russland durch das Georgia Aquarium. 


2019 appellierte sie an den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin, fast 100 Belugas und 

Orcas

 freizulassen, die für die Haltung in Meeresparks vorgesehen waren. Die Tiere wurden anschließend ins Meer zurückgebracht; Russland untersagte im selben Jahr ihre entsprechende Gefangennahme. 


Auch für andere Tiere setzte sich Panettiere ein 


Panettieres Engagement beschränkte sich nicht auf Meeressäuger. Während der Dreharbeiten zur Serie 

Heroes

 ließ sie beispielsweise die Arbeiten unterbrechen, um Vögel zu schützen, die von einem Crewmitglied mit einem Laubbläser vertrieben wurden. 


Gemeinsam mit unseren internationalen Partnerorganisationen erinnern wir von PETA Deutschland durch die Veröffentlichung ihrer letzten Kampagne an Panettieres langjährigen Einsatz für Tiere. Hayden Panettiere starb wenige Wochen

 

nach den Aufnahmen für die Kampagne. Sie richtete sich dabei an alle Menschen, die Delfine schützen möchten: Unterstützen Sie keine Einrichtungen, die die Tiere zu 

Unterhaltungszwecken

 gefangen halten.

title: COVERDALE SHOOT STOPPED BY SABS ON THE INGLORIOUS TWELFTH
content:
The HSA has continually

shared footage and information

 exposing the destruction and cruelty caused by the shooting industry. The extent of the persecution knows no bounds with badgers, foxes, corvids and all manner of wildlife being killed as the land is stripped of any natural balance just to appease those in tweed.


Snare found on the Walshaw Estate, West Yorkshire, January 2024.


So, as is customary, on the 12th of August, coined the ‘glorious twelfth’ by shooters, sabs joined forces to stop them and save lives.


Upon entering the Yorkshire Dales, it quickly became apparent that North Yorkshire police were ready and waiting to try and delay and prevent sabs from achieving their mission. Sab vehicles were pulled over, and dispersal orders were quickly scribbled out, but sabs are not easily deterred and great teamwork and communication meant that some groups made it onto the moors where they prevented the Coverdale shoot from a day’s killing.


North Yorkshire police enabling the slaughtering of Grouse.


In frustration their main transport vehicle drove at sabs while the police were present, drawing attention to the fact that their vehicle had no tax, leaving the tweed clad sour faces to walk to a nearby farm to await collection.


Sabs congregated on the moors to prevent the Coverdale shoot from a day’s killing.

© Newcastle Hunt Sabs


As well as witnessing the sheer lengths the police will go to to protect this blood sport it was also glaringly apparent the extent of damage being done to the moors for this high money business.


The entire ecology of the moors has been altered to accommodate this industry with desolate and barren views stretching far and wide and with the UK reaching record high temperatures over the past few years, wildfires are becoming more common as the intensive management of grouse moors creates the perfect conditions for it to spread.


Shoots burn heather on the moors resulting in a reduction in biodiversity and the release of stored carbon dioxide.


Without a doubt shooting isn’t just a blood sport, it is extremely detrimental to the environment, and the HSA will continue to expose it.

title: 1500 Captive Mink Liberated Last Night From Oregon Fur Farm (USA)
content:
Although an anonymous communique has yet to be received by the North American Animal Liberation Press Office, activists appear to have liberated 1500 captive mink from Cascade Fur Farm at 7582 Hunsaker Road SE in Turner, Oregon early this morning, according to local news media. The perimeter fence was cut allowing the genetically wild animals access to freedom, whereas they would have all been killed by the owners, John, Donna and Randy Lucas, sometime in November or December.

Reading from their usual playbook, industry spokesman Challis Hobbs recited the dis-proven propaganda about the animals being unable to survive in the wild, dying from thirst, starvation or being run over by cars, and that most of the animals returned to the farm voluntarily to await execution. In reality, its has been shown in scientific studies that farmed mink remain genetically wild and routinely survive long-term after release. They are also indigenous to the area, and while there may be environmental impacts, their chance of survival is quite good.

Mink are genetically wild animals that roam up to 5 miles a day but are kept in 10-inch cages on fur farms; their treatment is egregiously cruel and violent. The mink are born in February or March and are killed by gassing, clubbing or anal electrocution in November, before being skinned, sometimes while still alive, for their fur. The animals liberated last night have a fighting chance at life; they faced a 100 percent death rate if they stayed on the farm.

The number of fur farms in America has dwindled from more than 300 in the 1990s to less than 50 today, as the fur industry continues its steady decline into oblivion. A listing of all known fur farms in North America, is available here: https://finalnail.com/

author: PETA-Team
title: Naturwildpark Granat: Luchs entflohen und erschossen | Update
content:
Update vom 10. August 2026 


Luchs entflieht aus dem Naturwildpark und wird von Jäger erschossen  


Nachdem Luchs Mikaesch Ende Juli 2026 aus seinem Gehege im Naturwildpark Granat entkommen war, wurde er am 8. August, rund zwei Wochen später, von einem Jäger getötet. Berichten zufolge soll der Luchs den Hund eines Spaziergängers bedroht haben. Luchse gelten jedoch als sehr scheu und meiden Menschen in der Regel. Wie Mikaesch aus seinem Gehege fliehen konnte, bleibt bislang unklar.  


Der Vorfall wirft erneut Fragen zur Haltung von Tieren im Naturwildpark Granat auf. Erst im März 2026 haben wir von PETA Deutschland Strafanzeige gegen den Betreiber wegen des Verdachts auf Vernachlässigung einiger Tiere erstattet. Die Haltung von Luchsen und anderen Tieren in Zoos und Wildparks muss endlich beendet werden.  


„Erst eingesperrt, dann ausgebrochen und schließlich erschossen: Mikaesch hat die Sehnsucht nach Freiheit mit dem Leben bezahlt. Immer wieder kommt es in Zoos zu Unfällen und Ausbrüchen, die für die Tiere tödlich enden können und auch Menschen und andere Tiere in Gefahr bringen. Kein noch so großes Gehege kann den natürlichen Bedürfnissen von Wildtieren gerecht werden. Wer verhindern will, dass die Gefangenschaft für weitere Tiere tödlich endet, muss aufhören, fühlende Lebewesen für die Schaulust von Menschen auszustellen.“ 

Dr. Yvonne Würz, Biologin und Fachreferentin bei PETA Deutschland  


Update vom 20. März 2026

 


Aktuelle Fotos deuten erneut auf Vernachlässigung hin 


Ende Februar 2026 erreichte uns bei PETA Deutschland eine Whistleblower-Meldung mit aktuellen Fotos, die ein Mufflon im Naturwildpark Granat mit überlang gewachsenen, sogenannten Schnabelhufen zeigen. Aufgrund von Fehlstellungen kann dies mit erheblichen Schmerzen für das Tier verbunden sein. Wir haben das Kreisveterinäramt Recklinghausen darüber verständigt und aufgefordert, die Tierhaltung umfassend zu überprüfen.  


Bereits im Herbst 2025 wurde uns und der Veterinärbehörde durch einen Augenzeugen von einer ähnlichen Beobachtung berichtet. Wenn Tiere möglicherweise über Monate hinweg mit schmerzhaft überlangen Hufen leben müssen, ist das ein klares Zeichen für Vernachlässigung. Daher werden wir nun erneut Strafanzeige gegen die Wildpark-Verantwortlichen erstatten.  


PETA hatte ähnliche Missstände bereits 2022 nach mehreren Meldungen von Augenzeug:innen beim zuständigen Veterinäramt im Kreis Recklinghausen angezeigt und Strafanzeige erstattet. Damals stellte die Staatsanwaltschaft Essen das Verfahren ein, nachdem die Behörde keine Verstöße festgestellt hatte.  


Update vom März 2023:

 

Trotz Augenzeugenberichten: Staatsanwaltschaft Essen stellt Verfahren gegen Betreiber des Parks ein 

 


Im Jahr 2022 hatten wir nach einer Augenzeugenmeldung Strafanzeige gegen den Betreiber des Naturwildparks Granat erstattet. Damals berichteten Besucher:innen von verschiedenen Missständen in der Haltung der Tiere, darunter ein humpelndes Schwein im 

Streichelzoobereich

. Fotos dokumentierten ein Mufflon mit stark deformierten Hufen. Das Bildmaterial legte unserer Einschätzung nach nahe, dass die Erkrankung des Tieres bereits mehrere Monate unbehandelt blieb. Laut Augenzeug:innen konnte das Mufflon kaum noch laufen.  


Nach der medialen Berichterstattung über die von uns erstattete Strafanzeige wandten sich drei weitere Augenzeug:innen an uns und berichteten ebenfalls von verschiedenen tierquälerischen Missständen. Dennoch stellte die Staatsanwaltschaft Essen das Verfahren im März 2023 ein. Der Betreiber des Wildparks gab an, dass ein regelmäßiger Hufschnitt in Freigehegen normalerweise nicht erforderlich sei, da sich die Hufe durch natürliche Bewegung abnutzen würden. Das betroffene Tier habe erst mit zeitlicher Verzögerung eingefangen werden können, um einen Hufschnitt durchzuführen.  


Wir kürten das Kreisveterinäramt Recklinghausen im Jahr 2022 als 

eine der fünf schlechtesten Veterinärbehörden Deutschlands

, weil dieses nach Ansicht von PETA nicht konsequent gegen die Missstände vorging. 


Schnabelhufe und deren körperlichen Folgen 


Bei der sogenannten Hufrehe, einer schmerzhaften Entzündung der Huflederhaut, können im chronischen Stadium sogenannte Schnabelhufe auftreten. Damit es nicht zu dieser krankhaften Veränderung kommt, müssen Tierhaltende regelmäßig die Klauen kontrollieren, kürzen und pflegen. Tiere, die lahmen, müssen tiermedizinisch versorgt werden. Bleibt diese Versorgung aus, ist das tierschutzwidrig.

title: Önalan: Geothermal potential is not being used effectively
content:
A geothermal energy law was enacted in Turkey in 2007, and from 2008 onwards, the private sector in particular began building and commissioning large numbers of geothermal power plants. However, these facilities have caused serious ecological damage in many of the areas where they operate. Experts attribute much of this damage to failures by the plants to comply with environmental and public health standards.


Koray Çetin Önalan, Chair of the Izmir Branch of the Chamber of Geological Engineers (CGE), told Mezopotamya Agency (MA) that Turkey has some of the richest geothermal resources in the Middle East and Europe. Önalan said: “Turkey is very rich not only in geothermal energy, but in renewable energy resources more broadly. Geothermal energy is just one part of that potential. The problem we have reached today is that geothermal plants and resources have been geared almost exclusively towards energy production.”


Geothermal could meet much of Turkey’s energy shortfall


Önalan spoke about shortcomings in regulation and oversight. He said: “Because mistakes were made from the outset, because the first button was fastened wrong, so to speak, we have encountered serious environmental problems in the use of geothermal resources for energy production. With proper oversight, geothermal is actually a very clean source of energy. The problem is that we are exploiting geothermal resources very intensively. A model was developed in which these resources were used almost entirely for electricity generation. From the very beginning, adequate measures were not put in place to regulate and monitor these plants. But what we now know very clearly is that, with proper oversight, geothermal resources have the potential to meet a significant share of Turkey’s energy shortfall.”


Geothermal resources have many untapped uses


Önalan said geothermal resources are being used almost exclusively for energy production despite having a wide range of other potential applications:


“The use of geothermal resources in modern agriculture is particularly important. Greenhouse farming, for example. Their use for heating and cooling is also extremely important. Aydın is perhaps one of the areas with the richest geothermal potential. Geothermal resources are abundant across much of Aydın. Yet not a single residential area, including Efeler, the central district of Aydın, has been considered for geothermal heating. Today, Aydın is heated with natural gas. This is very strange and points to a serious failure in planning.”


Effective oversight is essential to prevent environmental harm


Önalan addressed shortcomings in oversight and explained how geothermal resources should be used: “We need to question whether there are enough qualified inspectors. You cannot oversee an area as vast as Aydın and the Büyük Menderes Graben with just three people. We therefore need effective oversight if we are to make proper use of geothermal resources.


There is no doubt that geothermal resources can be harmful when released into the environment. What matters is how you regulate them and how you use them for the public good. We are not approaching geothermal resources from a social perspective. If they are used solely for energy production, they do not provide a direct benefit to society. But if you use geothermal resources to heat and cool cities and in agriculture, then they can genuinely serve the public good.”


Future energy policies must be developed with society


Çetin Önalan said there is still a considerable lack of public knowledge about geothermal resources and stressed the need to raise awareness and address people’s concerns. He also underlined that the state must develop its future energy policies together with society. 


Önalan continued: “We believe that businesses, companies and the state have so far struggled to gain public trust and have, in fact, made mistakes in the way they approached the issue. A few bad examples emerged, and the entire system was then condemned. I want to stress this: had it not been for the actions of environmental organisations, we could be in a far worse situation today in terms of the environmental pollution caused by geothermal resources. Public participation is essential. What matters is that we talk more, listen to one another more and reach more accurate information. We need to build public confidence, but we also need to listen to people. What do they think? What are they afraid of? What are they concerned …

title: Ege Denizi’nin ‘yılkıları’: Orkinoslar
content:
İzmir – Anadolu’nun kadim coğrafyasında hüzünlü bir gelenek vardır: Yılkı atları. Mevsim kışa döndüğünde; yaşlanan, hastalanan ya da artık sahibine iş gücü ve kâr sağlamayan atlar, yem ve bakım maliyetlerinden kaçınmak amacıyla bozkırın dondurucu ayazına, yani doğanın insafına salınır. Kendi kaderlerine terk edilen bu canlılar ya hayatta kalmanın bir yolunu bulur ya da bozkırın ortasında sessizce can verip kurda kuşa yem olurlar. Bugün, bu eski bozkır trajedisinin sarsıcı bir benzeri, modern endüstrinin ve kapitalist üretim çarklarının gölgesinde Ege’nin mavi sularında sahneleniyor. Çeşme’nin kapalı körfezlerindeki endüstriyel kafeslerde tutulan, kâr getirdiği sürece yapay zekayla takip edilen ve tonlarca yemle beslenen mavi yüzgeçli orkinoslar, hastalandıkları an modern dünyanın yeni “yılkı atları” haline geliyor. İşte bu haber Ege Denizi’nin yılkı atları orkinosların ölümü ile ilgili.

Çeşme ve Karaburun kıyılarında son dönemde yaşanan kitlesel orkinos ölümleri bölgede büyük bir endişe kaynağı haline geldi. Eski Çevre ve Şehircilik Bakanlığı Müsteşarı Prof. Dr. Mustafa Öztürk, bu ölümlerin arkasında yatan temel nedenin deniz kirliliği olduğunu belirtiyor. Kıyıya vuran balıkların kesinlikle tüketilmemesi gerektiğini vurgulayan Öztürk, halk sağlığı açısından ciddi risklerin oluşabileceğini dile getiriyor. Son yıllarda Çeşme sahillerinde binden fazla ölü orkinosun kıyıya vurmasıyla görünür olan bu felaket, deniz ekosistemindeki bozulmayı ve insan eliyle yaratılan kirliliğin boyutlarını gözler önüne seriyor.

Yapılan laboratuvar analizleri ve Bursa Uludağ Üniversitesi Veteriner Fakültesi uzmanlarının yürüttüğü bilimsel çalışmalar, orkinos ölümlerinin ardındaki biyolojik etkeni ortaya koyuyor. Araştırmacılar, ölümlere kapsüllü Lactococcus garvieae adlı bir bakterinin yol açtığını tespit ediyor. Bu bakteri, deniz suyu sıcaklığının yükselmesiyle birlikte balıklarda ağır bir enfeksiyona sebebiyet veriyor. Özellikle yaz aylarında su sıcaklığının yirmi iki ile yirmi beş derece arasına ulaşması bakterinin yayılımını hızlandırıyor. Balıkların bağışıklık sistemini çökerterek kalp, karaciğer ve dalak gibi iç organlarını tahrip eden bu hastalık, ilerleyen evrelerde deride yaralara ve pul dökülmelerine yol açıyor. Balıkların mukoza tabakasının zarar görmesi ise hastalığın son evresini oluşturuyor ve halsiz düşen canlılar yönlerini kaybederek kıyıya sürükleniyor.

Bölgedeki çevre örgütleri, bakterinin bu denli ölümcül hale gelmesindeki asıl tetikleyici gücün denetimsiz üretim faaliyetleri ve deniz kirliliği olduğuna dikkat çekiyor. Çeşme’nin kuzey kıyılarında, özellikle Gerence ve Ildır gibi su sirkülasyonunun zayıf olduğu kapalı körfezlerde yoğunlaşan orkinos çiftlikleri, ekolojik taşıma kapasitesinin çok üzerinde çalıştırılıyor. Kafeslerdeki binlerce devasa balığın dışkıları, her gün denizlere dökülen tonlarca yem artığı ve organik atıklar zamanla körfezlerde büyük bir kirlilik yükü oluşturuyor. Çiftliklerden sızan ve esintiyle sahile doğru taşınan bu atıklar, deniz yüzeyinde ağır kokulu, yağlı bir kirlilik tabakası meydana getiriyor. Bu durum deniz dibindeki canlı yaşamını da yok olma noktasına getiriyor.

Kapitalist kâr hırsı doğrultusunda hareket eden bazı işletmelerin, hastalanmış ve ölmek üzere olan orkinosları imha maliyetlerinden kaçınmak amacıyla kafeslerin dışına, yani açık denize saldığı iddiaları yerel balıkçılar tarafından sıklıkla dile getiriliyor. Çiftliklerde ölen balıkların lisanslı bertaraf firmalarına teslim edilerek imha edilmesi gerekirken, bu işlem ek masraf yarattığı için hastalıklı canlılar denize bırakılıyor. Açık denizde can çekişen ve yönünü şaşıran zayıf düşmüş orkinoslar da akıntıların etkisiyle kıyılara vurarak sahillerde ölüyor.

Yaşanan ölümlerin tüm Ege sahillerine eşit dağılmaması, kirliliğin bölgesel ve sistemsel olduğu yönündeki iddiaları güçlendiriyor. Türkiye genelindeki beş büyük orkinos çiftliğinin dördü Çeşme bölgesinde yer alırken, sadece bir tanesi Seferihisar Sığacık Körfezi kıyılarında bulunuyor. Sığacık bölgesindeki çiftlikte ve çevresindeki doğal sularda ölümlerin neredeyse hiç görülmemesi veya son derece sınırlı kalması dikkat çekiyor. Yapılan bilimsel ölçümler, Sığacık Körfezi’ndeki güçlü akıntılar ve açık deniz etkileri sayesinde su sirkülasyonunun yüksek olduğunu ve kirlilik riskinin düşük kaldığını gösteriyor. Buna karşılık Çeşme’nin dar ve sığ körfezlerinde aşırı üretim yapılması, doğanın kendisini yenileme gücünü elinden alıyor ve felaketi kaçınılmaz hale getiriyor.
